sa: विसृष्टस्य रणे तस्य परमास्त्रस्य संग्रह। अशक्तः पाण्डवादन्यः साक्षादपि शतक्रतुः॥
en: Not excepting the great Indra himself, there was none save the son of Pandu, who could withdraw that high weapon after it had one been discharged.

sa: आत्मज्ञानमिदं ज्ञानं ज्ञात्वा पञ्चस्ववस्थितम्। यं ज्ञानेनाभिगच्छन्ति तस्मै ज्ञानात्मने नमः॥
en: Knowing that knowledge which knows the five elements to be the true Self-knowledge people approach you by knowledge. Salutations to you in your form of Knowledge.

sa: एते चान्ये च बहवो गणाः शत्रुभयंकराः॥ अनुजग्मुर्महात्मानं त्रिदशेन्द्रस्य सम्मते।
en: These and many other fairs (of the mothers), all capable of terrorizing the enemies, followed, the great Kartikeya, at the command of the king of gods.

sa: तेऽब्रुवन् सहितास्तत्र राजानं शल्यसंनिधौ। कृतयत्ना रणे राजन् सम्पूज्य विधिवत्तदा॥
en: All of them then, O king, who were bent on fighting, duly worshipped the king and said to him, in the presence of Shalya, these words.

sa: कालाकालौ सम्प्रधार्य बलाबलमथात्मनः। परस्य च बलं ज्ञात्वा तत्रात्मानं नियोजयेत्॥
en: Noting the opportune and inopportune moment, reflecting upon his own strength by comparing it with that of the enemy, the king should take up his work.

sa: तेन क्रीतेन यज्ञेन ततो यज्ञः प्रतायते। इत्येवं धर्मतो ध्यातमृषिभिर्धर्मचारिभिः॥
en: Pious Rishis have declared, according to the dictates of morality, that a sacrifice performed with the income of the sale of Soma serves to extend sacrifices.

sa: हतभूयिष्ठयोधा तु तव सेना विशाम्पते। किंचिच्छेषा महाराज कृपणं समपद्यत॥
en: Then your army, O king, which had lost a very large number of men and consisted of a very few soldiers, became highly depressed. O king.

sa: यः सहस्रं सहस्राणां राज्ञामयुतयाजिनाम्। ईजानो वितते यज्ञे ब्राह्मणेभ्यः सुसंहितः॥
en: That king, in one of his sacrifices dedicated to the Brahmanas, for serving them, a million of kings who had themselves celebrated thousands of sacrifices each.

sa: विशस्तं भ्रातरं दृष्ट्वा कर्णपुत्रौ महारथौ। सुषेणः सत्यसेनश्च मुञ्चन्तौ विविधाशरान्॥
en: Meanwhile, beholding their brother slain, the two sons of Karna, viz., Sushena and Satyasena, both of whom were great carwarriors, made a downpour of sharp arrows.

sa: एतान्यप्रतिमेयानि कृत्वा कर्माणि भारत। न प्रीयसे महाराज पूज्यमानो द्विजातिभिः॥
en: Having, O Bharata, made such wonderful conquests, and having obtained (through them) the worship of the Brahmanas, how is it that your mind is not satisfied.

sa: त्वया कालोपसृष्टेन लोभतो नापवर्जिताः। तवापराधान्नृपते सर्वं क्षत्रं क्षयं गतम्॥
en: Out of covetousness, and as destiny would nave it, you did not grant my request. Through you folly, O king, all the Kshatriyas have been exterminated.

sa: तमुवाच महाबाहुर्जामदग्न्यः प्रतापवान्। कस्त्वं कस्माच्च नरकं प्रतिपन्नो ब्रवीहि तत्॥
en: The highly energetic and the mighty armed son of Jamadagni said to him,-Who are you? And why did you fall into hell? Tell me all this.

sa: अथ यो गुणसम्पन्नान् हृदयस्याप्रियानपि। प्रियेण कुरुते वश्यांश्चिरं यशसि तिष्ठति॥
en: That king, who wins over accomplished persons by doing good to them even though he may not like them heartily, succedes in enjoying fame for ever.

sa: राजपुत्री च पाञ्चालीमेकवस्त्रां रजस्वलाम्। भवत्या विदितं सर्वमुक्तवान् यत् सुतस्तव॥
en: You know what your son had said to the princes of Panchala while the latter, in her seasons, was clad in a single piece of cloth.

sa: क्षीणवद् विह्वलत्वात् तु निमेषात् पुनरुत्थितः॥ भीमसेनो गदापाणि: समाह्वयत मद्रपम्।
en: Bhimasena, rising up, however, within the twinkling of an eye and still reeling as if drunk, challenged, with an uplifted mace, the king of the Madras.

sa: तृप्ताश्च सुभृशं तेन सुखिता विगतज्वराः। नृत्यन्तश्च हसन्तश्च यथा स्वर्गजितस्तथा॥
en: Highly pleased with that blood, cheerfully and without anxiety of any kind, they danced and laughed there like persons that have (by virtue) attained to heaven.

sa: रुदिताद् विरता ह्येता ध्यायन्त्यः सपरिच्छदाः। कुरुस्त्रियोऽभिगच्छन्ति तेन तेनैव दुःखिताः॥
en: Those Kuru ladies have ceased weeping with their followers and companions. They are all filled with anxiety. Bewilders with sorrows, they are running here and there.

sa: आहूयोवाच तां भार्यां सर्चीको भार्गवस्तदा। उपभोज्यश्चरुरयं त्वया मात्राप्ययं तव॥
en: Calling his wife, Richika of Bhrigu's race, said,This portion of the sanctified food should be taken by you, and this (the other) portion by your mother.

sa: यथा देवासुरं युद्धं पूर्वमासीद् विशाम्पते। अभीतानां तथा राजन् यमराष्ट्रविवर्धनम्॥
en: The battle between fearless combatants resembled, O king that between the gods and the Asuras in days of yore and increased the population of Yama's kingdom.

sa: तावभ्यधावतां तीक्ष्णौ द्वावप्येनं महारथम्। शरोधान् सम्यगस्यन्तौ जीमूतौ सलिलं यथा।॥
en: Both of them covered the great car-worrier Nakula with keen arrows. When they discharged arrows, they looked like two masses of clouds pouring rain in torrents.

sa: मत्ता रुधिरगन्धेन बहवोऽत्र विचेतसः। जघ्नुः परान् स्वसांश्चैव प्राप्तान प्राप्ताननन्तरान्॥
en: Maddened with the smell of blood, many became so insensible that they killed friends and foes alike, in fact, every one they could lay hold on.

sa: मित्रता सर्वभूतेषु दानमध्ययनं तपः। ब्राह्मणस्यैव धर्म: स्यान्न राज्ञो राजसत्तम॥
en: Love for all creatures, charity, study of the Vedas, penances, are are the duties of a Brahniana and not of a king, O best of kings!

sa: साहं सर्वाधमा लोके स्त्रीणां भरतसत्तम॥ तथा विनिकृता पुत्रैर्याहमिच्छामि जीवितुम्।
en: O best of the Bharatas, I am the worst of all females, since I wish to live on even though I am deprived of my children.

sa: यो बद्ध्वा त्रिशतं चाश्वान् देवेभ्यो यमुनामनु। सरस्वती विंशतिं च गङ्गामनु चतुर्दश॥ अश्वमेधसहस्रेण राजसूयशतेन च। इष्टवान् स महातेजा दौष्यन्तिर्भरतः पुरा॥
en: Dedicating three hundred horses to the gods on the banks of Yamuna, twenty on the banks of Sarasvati, and fourteen on the banks of Ganga, that highly energetic king, in days of old, (celebrated this order) a thousand Horsesacrifices and a hundred Rajasuyas. In days of yore, effulgent Bharata, the son of Dushyanta celebrated sacrifices.

sa: ये पुरा शेरते वीराः शयनेषु यशस्विनः। चन्दनागुरुदिग्धाङ्गास्तेऽद्य पांसुषु शेरते॥
en: Those great heroes who used formerly to sleep on rich beds with their limbs smeared with sandal-paste and powered alone, are now sleeping on the dust.

sa: ततस्तेदेवेत्यभिपूज्य सत्वरं जनार्दनं कर्णमविध्यदर्जुनः। स्तथा यथा शम्बरहा पुरा बलिम्॥
en: In pursuance of Krishna's order and i worshipping him the Kuru hero Arjuna again struck Karna with many powerful arrows like Indra striking the Asura Shamvara.

sa: हताश्वे तु रथे तिष्ठन् द्रोणपुत्रस्त्वयस्मयम्॥ मुसलं पाण्डुपुत्राय चिक्षेप परिघोपमम्।
en: Staying on that horseless car Drona's son, smiling, discharged, at the son of Pandu a heavy mallet that looked like a dreadful mace with iron spikes.

sa: हतभूयिष्ठयोधा तु तव सेना विशाम्पते। किंचिच्छेषा महाराज कृपणं समपद्यत॥
en: Then your army, O king, which had lost a very large number of men and consisted of a very few soldiers, became highly depressed. O king.

sa: न केनचिद् याचितव्यः कश्चित्किञ्चिदनापदि। इति व्यवस्था भूतानां पुरस्तान्मनुना कृता॥
en: No one should ask anything of any one when on distress prevails. Manu himself in days of yore has laid down this injunction regarding all men.

sa: ध्वजाग्रं चास्य समरे कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः॥ प्रमुखे वर्तमानस्य भल्लेनापाहरद् रथात्।
en: With a broad-headed arrow, Yudhishthira, the son of Kunti, then cut off from his car the standard of his antagonist as the latter stood before him.

sa: सोऽब्रवीदहमासं प्राग्दंशो नाम महासुरः। पुरा देवयुगे तात भृगोस्तुल्यवया इव॥
en: He answered,-Formerly I was a great Asura by the name of Dansha. In the Krita cycle, O sire, I was of the same age with Bhrigu.

sa: अश्मानं ब्राह्मणं प्राज्ञं वैदेहो जनको नृपः। संशयं परिपप्रच्छ दुःखशोकसमन्वितः॥
en: Janaka the king of the Videhas, O king, filled with sorrow and grief, asked a wise Brahmana of the name of Ashma for removing his doubts.

sa: यत् तद् बलममित्राणां तथा वीर्यसमुद्यतम्। हस्त्यश्वरथसम्पनं त्रिभिरङ्गैरनुत्तमम्॥ रक्षित द्रोणकर्णाभ्यामश्वत्थाम्ना कृपेण च। तत त्वया निहतं वीर तस्माद् भुक्ष्व वसुन्धराम्॥
en: That army of the enemy, O hero, ready to attack you with all its might, consisting of elephants and horses and cars, protected by Drona and Karna and Ashvatthaman and Kripa, has been defeated and killed by you, O hero. It is for this that I request you to enjoy the Earth.

sa: यो वाप्यस्थिरसंकल्पो बुद्धिमानागतागमः। उपायज्ञोऽपि नालं स कर्म प्रापयितुं चिरम्॥
en: A person, again, who is of unsettled purposes, even if endued with intelligence and learning, and even if conversant with means, cannot long act with success.

sa: अयुध्यमानो म्रियते युद्धयमानस्तु जीवति। कालं प्राप्य महाराज न कश्चिदतिवर्तते॥
en: One may die without fighting in battle. One also escapes alive after having engaged in battle. When one's appointed Time comes, O king, he cannot escape.

sa: शिखण्डिनं समासाद्य मृगेन्द्र इव जम्बुकम्। द्रोणश्च ब्राह्मणो यत्र सर्वशस्त्रास्त्रपारगः॥
en: When the Brahmana Drona, the master of all offensive and defensive, weapons has been killed by the Pandavas in battle, what can it be but Destiny?

sa: रुद्राक्रीडनिभं दृष्ट्वा तदा विशसनं स्त्रियः। महाहेभ्योऽथ यानेभ्यो विक्रोशन्त्यो निपेतिरे॥
en: Seeing that onslaught which resembled the spectacles seen on the sporting ground of Rudra, the ladies cried and quickly got down from their costly cars. were

sa: भूरिश्रवा हतो यत्र सोमदत्तश्च संयुगे। बाह्निकश्च महाराजः किमन्यद् भागधेयतः॥
en: When Bhagadatta, an expert in fighting from the back of elephants, has been killed and when Jayadratha has been slain, what can it be but Fate?

sa: नारदप्रमुखाश्चापि सर्वे देवर्षयोऽनघ तत्र चापि मया हृष्टा पृथिवी पृथिवीपते॥
en: There were, O sinless one, all the celestial Rishis also, headed by Narada. There, O king, I saw also the Earth in her embodied form. saw

sa: त्वमप्येवंविधं हित्वा योगेन नियतेन्द्रियः। वर्तस्व बुद्धिमूलं तु विजयं मनुरब्रवीत्॥
en: As for yourself, avoiding idleness and controlling your senses, do everything in the world with proper means. Manu himself has declared that victory rests upon intelligence.

sa: तानपास्य गताः केचित् पुनरेव युयुत्सवः॥ कुर्वन्तस्तव पुत्रस्य शासनं युद्धदुर्मदाः।
en: Leaving behind the wounded, some, incapable of being easily defeated in battle once more advanced to battle desirous of carrying out the commands of your son.

sa: ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा बाणजालेन पीडितः। बभूवाद्भुतविक्रान्तो जम्भो वृत्रहणा यथा॥
en: At this, king Yudhishthira, afflicted with those arrows, felt himself deprived of his prowess, even as the Asura Jambha had become before the killer of Vritra.

sa: अध्रुवा सर्वमत्र्येषु श्रीरूपालक्ष्यते भृशम्। भवतो व्यसनं दृष्ट्वा शक्रविस्पर्धिनो भृशम्॥
en: Forsooth, the prosperity of all mortals is very unstable, since you, who were equal unto Shakra himself, have now been reduced to such a miserable condition.'

sa: तथाविधस्य सुहृदा क्षन्तव्यं स्वं विजानता। ऐश्वर्यमिच्छता नित्यं पुरुषेण बुभूषता॥
en: The king replied to him, saying,—Why should I not hear anything which you will say, since I am not blind to what is for my good?

sa: न हि ज्ञानविरुद्धेषु बह्वपायेषु कर्मसु। मूलघातिषु सज्जन्ते बुद्धिमन्तो भवद्विधाः॥
en: Intelligent persons like you, O king, never commit sinful deeds, that are disapproved by knowledge and that strike at the very root of virtue and happiness.

sa: ततोऽब्रवीत् सुराज्शको न मे शक्या महासुराः॥ ऋतेऽस्थिभिर्दधीचस्य निहन्तुं त्रिदशद्विषः।
en: Shakra then said to the gods-"The great Asuras are incapable of being defeated by me. Save with the bones of Dadhicha, our foes cannot be killed.

sa: यस्य बुद्धिः परिभवेत् तमतीतेन सान्त्वयेत्। अनागतेन दुष्प्रज्ञं प्रत्युत्पन्नेन पण्डितम्॥
en: You should assure him with references to the past whose sense you want to control. A wicked man should be assured by promises of future well-being.

sa: ऋषिः परमधर्मात्मा नारदो भगवान् प्रभुः। तवैवाभेद्यहृदयो मा तेऽभूदत्र संशयः॥
en: He is the illustrious and powerful Rishi Narada, that foremost of virtuous persons. He is your husband entirely devoted to you. Do not cherish any doubt.

sa: एकादश चमूर्भित्त्वा रक्ष्यमाणं महात्मना। सत्यं चिकीर्षता पश्य हतमेनं जयद्रथम्॥
en: Behold that Jayadratha, who was protected by the illustrious Drona, killed by Partha bent on making good his promise, after penetrating through eleven Akshauhinis of soldiers.

sa: केशवेनैवमुक्तोऽथ पाण्डवः परवीरहा। अवातरद् रथात् तूर्णं प्रगृह्य सशरं धनुः॥
en: Thus addressed by Keshava, Arjuna that destroyer of hostile heroes, quickly got down from the car, taking with him his bow with arrow fixed on string.

sa: अथाविष्टो भगवता भूयो जज्वाल तेजसा। वेगवांश्चाभवद् युद्धे देवसृष्टेन तेजसा॥
en: Possessed by that divine being, Drona's son was worked up with energy. On account of that energy derived from god-head, he became all powerful in battle.

sa: स तु मामश्रुपूर्णाक्षो नाशक्नोदभिवीक्षितुम्। उपप्रैक्षत मां दृष्ट्वा तथा दीनमवस्थितम्॥
en: His eyes were full of tears and, therefore, he could not see me. I stood depressed before him. He saw me but could not recognise me.

sa: छिन्नमूले त्वधिष्ठाने सर्वेषां जीवनं हतम्। कथ हि शाखास्तिष्ठेयुश्छिन्नमूले वनस्पतौ॥
en: When the root of a refuge is cut off, all the refugees die. When the root of a tree cut off, how would the branches live?

sa: इत्येवं गुरुभिः पूर्वमुपदिष्टं नृणां सदा। सोऽहमुत्क्रम्य पन्थानं शास्त्रदिष्टं सनातनम्॥
en: By neglecting the eternal way pointed out by the scriptures and by trying to follow a wrong path I have, however, fallen into a dreadful distress.

sa: तस्य तर्पयतो देवान् सरस्वत्यां महात्मनः। समीपतो महाराज सोऽपातिष्ठत भाविनी॥
en: On the banks of the Sarasvat the great sage was engaged in the worship of the gods and ! there the celestial nymphs, O king, arrived.

sa: समास्तु समतिक्रान्ता बह्वयः पूजयतो मम॥ न चायमलसो भिक्षुरभ्यभाषत किंचन।
en: The latter thought within himself-"Many years have I passed in adoring this ascetic. This idle mendicant, however, has not yet spoken to me a single word!"

sa: एवमेव प्रजाः सर्वा राजानमभिसंश्रिताः॥ सम्यग्वृत्ताः स्वधर्मस्था न कुतश्चिद् भयान्विताः।
en: When the king behaves himself thus, all his subjects, depending upon him, become virtuous in their behaviour, follow their duties, and are freed from every fear.

sa: पालयानः पितुः शास्त्रमूर्ध्वरेता महायशाः। एष शान्तनवः शेते माधवप्रतिमो युधि॥
en: For obeying the mandate of his father, this illustrious one drew up his vital seed. Peerless in battle, that son of Shantanu lies there, O Madhava.

sa: ननृतुश्च ववल्गुश्च जहसुश्च मुदान्विताः॥ शक्त्यस्त्रस्य तु राजेन्द्र ततोऽर्चिभिः समन्ततः।
en: Thousands of Daityas, O king, were reduced to ashes by the flames that came out Skanda's arrow, while other died at the very roars of Skanda.

sa: तस्य संकल्पमाज्ञाय भीमं प्रत्यशुभं हरिः। भीममाक्षिप्य पाणिभ्यां प्रददौ भीममायसम्॥
en: Understanding the wicked intentions towards Bhima, Krishna, dragging away the real Bhima, prusented an iron statue of the second son of Pandu to the old king.

sa: तं गृहीत्वैव पाणिभ्यां भीमसेनमयस्मयम्। बभञ्ज बलवान् राजा मन्यमानो वृकोदरम्॥
en: Holding with his two arms that iron Bhima, the power king Dhritarashtra, endued with great strength, broke it into pieces, taking it for the real Bhima.

sa: हतो वज्रभृता वृत्रस्त्वया कर्णो धनंजय। वृत्रकर्णवधं घो कथयिष्यन्ति मानवाः॥
en: Vritra was killed by the holder of thunderbolt and Karna has been killed by you. They will simultaneously talk of the destruction of Vritra and Karna.

sa: भूमि भित्त्वौषधीश्छित्त्वा वृक्षादीनण्डजान् पशून्। मनुष्यास्तन्वते यज्ञास्ते स्वर्ग प्राप्नुवन्ति च॥
en: Others living like householders and tilling the soil, uprooting herbs, cutting off trees and killing birds and animals celebrate sacrifices and at last attain to heaven.

sa: संदश्यमानस्तु तथा कृमिणा तेन भारत। गुरोः प्रबोधनाशङ्की तमुपैक्षत सूर्यजः॥
en: Though his limb was cut through by that worm, O Bharata, the son of Surya, lest his preceptor should awake, allowed it to do its pleasure.

sa: प्रयाणे मद्रराजोऽभून्मुखः व्यूहस्य दंशितः॥ मद्रकैः सिहतौ वीरैः कर्णपुत्रैश्च दुर्जयैः।
en: The king of the Madras, clad in mail, proceeded at the head of the army accompanied by the brave Madrakas and the invincible sons of Karna.

sa: न चाप्यवहसन् कञ्चिन्न कुर्वन् भृकुटी: क्वचित्। प्रसन्नवदनो नित्यं सर्वेन्द्रियसुसंयतः॥
en: I shall not inock at any one, nor shall I frown at any body. governing all my senses, I shall always put on a cheerful face.

sa: पाण्डवानां बलौघस्तु शल्यमासाद्य मारिष। व्यतिष्ठत तदा युद्धे सिन्धोर्वेग इवाचलम्॥
en: The huge army of the Pandavas, coming against Shalya, O sire, stood still in that battle, like the rushing deep upon being obstructed by a mountain.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच स्वकर्मण्यपरे युक्तास्तथैवान्ये विकर्मणि। तेषां विशेषमाचक्ष्व ब्राह्मणानां पितामह॥
en: Yudhishthira said O grandfather, amongst Brahmanas some follow the duties proper to their order while others follow other duties. Tell me the difference between tow lasses.

sa: पुत्रशोकाभिसंतप्तं धर्मादपकृतं मनः। तव राजेन्द्र तेव त्वं भीमसेनं जिघांससि॥
en: On account of the sorrow for the death of your sons, your mind has been filled with spite. Therefore, O great king, you seek kill Bhimasena.

sa: सर्वविद्यातिरेकेण जयमिच्छेन्महीपतिः। न मायया न दम्भेन य इच्छेद् भूतिमात्मनः॥
en: That king who wishes for his own prosperity should try to make conquests by fair means, but never with deceit but ones on or with pride.'

sa: पशूनेतानहं त्यक्त्वा भिक्षिष्ये राजसत्तमम्। एवमुक्त्वा ततो राजऋषीन् सवान् प्रतापवान्॥
en: Dalvya-vaka, then said to those Rishis-"Do you divide those animals among ye! Giving away these (to ye), I shall beg a great king (for some more).'

sa: तस्य चिन्तयतस्तावच्छायाभूतं महाद्युति। तेजो विग्रहवत् तात शरीरमजहात् तदा॥ तमपृच्छन्महाकायं प्रह्लादः को भवानिति। प्रत्याहतं तु शीलोऽस्मि त्यक्तो गच्छाम्यहं त्वया।॥
en: While the Asura king sat brooding over the matter, a flame of light came out of his person. It had a shadowy form of great effulgence and huge proportions. Prahlada asked the form, saying,-Who are You?-The form answered, saying-—I am the embodiment of your conduct. Renounced by you I am going away.

sa: नाधर्मश्चरितो राजन् सद्यः फलति गौरिव। शनैरावय॑मानो हि कर्तुर्मूलानि कृन्तति॥
en: "O king, the sinful acts like the earth immediately do not bear fruit. But they do gradually and secretly cut away the roots of their doer.

sa: वीरभद्रवचः श्रुत्वा दक्षो धर्मभृतां वरः। तोषयामास स्तोत्रेण प्रणिपत्य महेश्वरम्॥
en: Hearing the words of Virabhadra, Daksha, that foremost of all pious men, bewed down unto Maheshvara and sought to please him by uttering the following hymn.

sa: सुहृत्कार्यं तु सुमहत् कृतं ते स्याज्जनार्दन। ततोऽभ्यावृत्य वार्ष्णेयो दुर्योधनममर्षणम्॥
en: Then will a very great duty of a friend have been done by you, O Janardana.” Then did the son of Vrishni addressing the wrathful Duryodhana,

sa: तद् दृष्ट्वा सोपधं कर्म कौशिकेन कृतं निशि॥ तद्भावकृतसंकल्पो द्रोणिरेकोऽन्वचिन्तयत्।
en: Witnessing that deed perpetrated in the night by the owl, Drona's son began to reflect on it, desirous of guiding his own conduct after that example.

sa: मेरोः पार्श्वमहं पूर्वं वक्ष्याम्यथ यथातथम्॥ तस्य मूर्धाभिषेकस्तु भद्राश्वस्य विशाम्पते।
en: I shall now describe to you the eastern side of the mountain Meru. O king, of all the regions there, one called Bhadrashva is the foremost.

sa: अयथावच्च ते वर्णो दीनश्चासि निशाचर। नासि कच्चिदमित्राणां क्रुद्धानां वशमागतः॥
en: Your colour has changed its natural aspect, and O ranger of the night, you look poorly. Did not come under the control of the wrathful foes?

sa: तस्मिन् घोरे सदा पार्थ संग्रामे रोमहर्षणे। द्रौणिकर्णकृपैर्गुप्तां महेष्वासैः प्रहारिभिः॥ कस्तां सेनां तदा पार्थ मनसापि प्रधर्षयेत्। ऋते देवान्महेष्वासाद् बहुरूपान्महेश्वरात्॥
en: In that dreadful battle, O son of Pritha, capable of causing the hair to stand erect, who else, O Arjuna, except the divine Maheshvara, that foremost of all bowmen, could even in his mind, dare defeat that host that was protected by those great smiters and bowmen, viz., Ashvatthaman, Karna and Kripa.

sa: ततः स विस्मयाविष्टो हृष्टरोमा धनंजयः। प्रणम्य शिरसा देवं कृताञ्जलिरभाषत॥
en: Then filled with amazement, Dhananjaya, with his hairs standing on end, his head lowly bowed down and his hands joined together, addressed the great God thus:

sa: एषासि निर्जिता भद्रे शत्रु जित्वा रणाजिरे। पौरुषात् यदनुष्ठेयं मयैतदुपपादितम्॥
en: O gentle one, destroying all the enemies in the arena of battle I have subdued your enemy-I have done all that can be accomplished by manliness.

sa: परस्परेण द्विगुणा: सर्वे द्वीपा नराधिप। पर्वताश्च महाराज समुद्रैः परिवारिताः॥
en: O king, the island are double in area of one another as they proceed further towards the north. O king, they are surrounded by these oceans.

sa: काननेषु च रम्येषु पर्वतेषु नदीषु च। निवसन्नानयामास वृष्णिदारान् धनञ्जयः॥
en: Dhananjaya, after abandoning Dwraka, proceeded by slow marches, causing the Vrishni women to rest in charming forests and mountain and by the sides of delightful rivers.

sa: श्रुत्वेदं भरतश्रेष्ठ भूमिपर्व मनोनुगम्॥ श्रीमान् भवति राजन्यः सिद्धार्थः साधुसम्मतः।
en: O best of the Bharata race, hearing this delightful Bhumi Parva, a Kshatriya obtains prosperity, the fruition of all his desires and approbation of the pious.

sa: ततः शरसहस्राणि प्रादुरासन् समन्ततः। तैः शरैस्तव सैन्यस्य विद्रवः सुमहानभूत्॥
en: Thereupon a thousand shafts started into existence from all sides. Great was the carnage that was then created in your troops by those arrows of Bhima.

sa: नौरेषा हि सुखास्तीर्णा ऋषीणां पुण्यकर्मणाम्। भगवन्तमिह प्राप्तं ज्ञात्वा त्वरितमागता॥
en: And learning that you have arrived at this place, the pious ascetics have speedily come hither, and have also brought this barque with a spacious carpet.

sa: परिवादं न च ब्रूयात् परेषामात्मनस्तथा। परिवादो धर्माय प्रोच्यते भरतर्षभ॥
en: One should neither 'vilify others reproach himself for, O chief of the Bharatas, it is said that calumny is sinful whether of others or of oneself.

sa: सा तु शोकपरिताङ्गी मैथिली जनकात्मजा। राक्षसीवशमापन्ना व्याघ्रीणां हरिणी यथा॥
en: And as a doe comes under the subjection of tigresses, Janaka's daughter, Maithili, her frame worked up with grief, came under the sway of the Raksasis.

sa: भीमसेनस्तु राजेन्द्र रथोऽष्टगुणसम्मितः। न तस्यास्ति समो युद्धे गदया सायकैरपि।॥
en: Bhimasena, O chief among kings, is held to be eight times a Ratha and in a fight with the mace or arrows he has no equal.

sa: कृपः शारद्वतो राजन् रथयूथपयूथपः। प्रियान् प्राणान् परित्यज्य प्रधक्ष्यति रिपूंस्तव॥
en: Kripa, the son of Sharadvata, Oking, is the general of the commanders of the Rathas, and careless of his dear life he will consume your enemies.

sa: प्रासादेषु विचित्रेषु गोष्ठीषूपवनेषु च। कथा विचित्राः कुर्वाणाः पण्डितास्तत्र शोभनाः।।२९।
en: It is in beautiful places, assemblies and gardens where beautiful speeches are to be made that the learned men seem to be in their proper places.

sa: शब्दः स्पर्शस्तथा रूपं रसो गन्धश्च पञ्चमः। इन्द्रियार्थान् पृथग्विद्यादिन्द्रियेभ्यस्तु नित्यदा॥
en: Sound, touch, from, taste, and scent for the fifth, are the objects of the (five) senses. These should always be considered as distinct from the senses.

sa: उषिताः स्म सुखं राज्ये तवास्मिन्सुमहाबल॥ इदं तु पतितं तस्मात्तव राम वशे स्थितान्। कालस्य वशमापन्नाः स्वल्पं हि नहि नः सुखम्॥
en: O you of great prowess, up to this time we have lived happily in your kingdom. And now, O Räma, under your subjection we are being troubled with the sorrow or our son's death. We have been brought under the influence of Kāla; so in your kingdom there is not the least happiness for us.

sa: दयार्थं बालखिल्यानां न च स्थानमविन्दत। स गत्वा पर्वतश्रेष्ठं गन्धमादनमञ्जसा॥
en: Wishing to save the Valakhilyas he could not find a (proper) place to sit on. At last he went to that best of mountains, called Gandhamadana.

sa: पाण्डवान् पृष्ठतः कृत्वा त्राणमाशंससेऽन्यतः। दुःशासने दुर्विषहे कर्णे चापि ससौबले॥
en: Keeping the sons of Pandu behind you, you repose your hopes for safety on other sources, namely on Dushasana, Durvisha, Karna and the son of Subala.

sa: आर्तस्य हृतदारस्य परुषं पुरुषान्तरात्। वचनं मर्षणीयं ते राघवस्य महात्मनः॥
en: Do you patiently hear all these harsh words of the high-souled Rāma, racked with sorrow and separated from his spouse, which Laksmana, shall relate to you.

sa: रावणाङ्कपरिक्लिष्टां दृष्टां दुष्टेन चक्षुषा। कथं त्वां पुनरादद्यां कुलं व्यपदिशन्महत्॥
en: You were taken by Rāvana on his lap, beheld by him with sinful eyes; how can I, taking you back, bring disgrace upon my great family?

sa: ब्राह्मे रात्रिक्षये प्राप्ते तस्य ह्यमिततेजसः॥ प्रसादात् प्रादुरभवत् पद्मं पद्मनिभेक्षण।
en: When Brahmana's night was passed, through the grace of that Being of great energy, a lotus made its appearance first, you having eyes like lotus petals.

sa: कृतज्ञं प्राज्ञमक्षुद्रं दृढभक्तिं जितेन्द्रियम्। धर्मनित्यं स्थितं नीत्यं मन्त्रिणं पूजयेन्नृपः॥
en: The king should duly honour the minister who is grateful, wise, large-hearted loyal, a master of his senses, virtuous, and observant of the dictates of policy.

sa: एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं प्रोच्यमानं द्विजोत्तम। तपसा हि प्रदीप्तेन सर्वं त्वमनुपश्यति॥
en: I wish to hear this, O foremost of twiceborn persons, and, therefore, have I asked you. By virtue of your blazing penances you see all things.

sa: रौहिणेये गते शूरे पुष्येण मधुसूदनः॥ पाण्डवेयान् पुरस्कृत्य ययावभिमुखः कुरून्।
en: After the heroic son of Rohini had started under the constellation Pushya, the slayer of Madhu, placing the Pandavas in his van, went against the Kurus.

sa: मद्विशिष्टाश्च तुल्याश्च सन्ति तत्र वनौकसः। मत्तः प्रत्यवरः कश्चिन्नास्ति सुग्रीवसंनिधौ॥
en: There are (in that army) rangers of woods, some equal and some superior to me. And near Sugrīva there are none who are inferior to me.

sa: स्त्रीत्वं तस्यानुसंस्मृत्य भीष्मो बाणाशिखण्डिने॥ जगान द्रुपदानीके रथान् सप्त महारथः।
en: Remembering Shikhandin's femininity Bhishma sped not a single arrow at the former. But that mighty car-warrior then slew seven of the best car-warriors of Draupada's division.

sa: स आत्मा पुरुषव्याघ्र भ्रुवोरन्तरमाश्रितः। बुद्धिं द्रव्येषु सृजति विविधेषु परावराम्॥
en: The Soul, O the most valiant of mortals stationing itself between the eye brows, sends the high and the low intellect to different objects (of sense).

sa: यज्वा दानपतिः श्रेष्ठः सर्वभूतहितप्रियः॥ कथंस्विदन्यथा ब्रूयादेष वाक्यं महान् वसुः।
en: He celebrates sacrifices. He is liberal in making gifts. He always seeks the well being of all creatures. How, indeed, will the great Vasu speak otherwise.

sa: एषा देवनदी पुण्या पार्थ त्रैलोक्यपावनी। आकाशगङ्गा राजेन्द्र तत्राप्लुत्य गमिष्यसि॥
en: Here is the celestial river, sacred and sanctifying the there worlds. It is called celestial Ganga, Plunging into it, you will go to your own regions.

sa: एतद् विशेषणं तात मनोबुद्ध्योर्यदन्तरम्। त्वमप्यत्राभिसम्बुद्धः कथं वा मन्यते भवान्॥
en: O my child, these are the points of distinction between the mind and the intellect you are also conversant with this subject. What do you say?

sa: एतेष्वैश्वर्यमाधाय भूतिमिच्छसि भारत। न चैते तव पर्याप्ता ज्ञाने धर्मार्थयोस्तथा॥
en: Reposing your kingly prosperity on them you wish for prosperity, O Bharata; but these friends of yours have not sufficient knowledge of virtue of worldly profit.

sa: पठ्यमानेषु मन्त्रेषु शान्त्यर्थं परमर्षिभिः। स्पृश्यमाना करैः शीतैः पाण्डवैश्च मुहुर्मुहुः॥
en: On the Mantras being recited by the great Rishis in order to restore her and on the repeated touch of the cool hands of the Pandavas.

sa: यत्तुं सूतेन शिष्टेन बहुशो दृष्टकर्मणा। दंशितः पाण्डुरेणाहं कवचेन वपुष्मता॥
en: Careful and well trained in battle and who had seen many deeds of bravery. I too, with my body covered with a white coat of mail,

sa: भीमसेनस्य वा राजन्नुपायकुशलैनरैः। मृत्युर्विधीयतां छन्नैः स हि तेषां बलाधिकः॥
en: O king, let some clever spies, full of resources, go there and secretly bring about the death of Bhimasena, he is the strongest of them all.

sa: प्रशान्तं च जगत्सर्वं सहस्राक्षे प्रतिष्ठिते। यज्ञं चाद्भुतसंकाशं तदा शक्रोऽभ्यपूजयत्॥
en: And Väsava being installed again on the throne, the whole universe was at rest. There upon Indra worshipped Vişnu in the shape of that wonderful sacrifice.

sa: अद्य वर्षसहस्रस्य समाप्तिर्मम राघव। सोऽहं भोजनमिच्छामि यथासिद्धं तवानघ ॥
en: For a thousand years I have carried on the vow of fasting. It has terminated today, so do you give me food as much as possible.

sa: अदुःखार्हा परं दुःखं प्राप्तेयं मृदुगामिनी। आश्वासय महाराज तामिमां श्रमकर्शिताम्॥
en: O great king, this lady of slow gait, though she does not deserve misery, suffers great afflictions. She is worn out with fatigue. Therefore comfort her.

sa: यस्य रश्मिसहस्रेषु शाखास्विव विहंगमाः। वसन्त्याश्रित्य मुनयः संसिद्धा दैवतैः सह॥
en: Numberless Munis, crowned with ascetic success, together with all the gods, live in the rays of the Sun like birds perching on the branches of trees.

sa: गुणान् यदिह पश्यन्ति तदिच्छन्त्यपरे जनाः। परं नैवाभिकाङ्क्षन्ति निर्गुणत्वाद् गुणार्थिनः॥
en: Others seeing worldly objects seek their possession. When they hanker after such objects, they do not see Brahma inasmuch as it is shorn of all attributes.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच कस्मात् सरस्वती ब्रह्मन् निवृत्ता प्राडमुखीभवत्। व्याख्यातमेतदिच्छामि सर्वमध्वर्युसत्तम॥
en: Janamejaya said "Why O Brahmana, did the Sarasvati bend her course there towards the east. O best of Adhvaryus, you should tell me everything regarding this.

sa: इत्येद्धास्तिनपुरे ब्राह्मणेनोपवर्णितम्। शम्पाकेन पुरा मह्यं तस्मात् त्यागः परो मतः॥
en: A Brahmana, told me all this, at Hastinapur, in times gone by, about what Champaka had sung. I hold Renunciation, therefore, as the foremost of things.

sa: तस्मादाशङ्कमानोऽहं वृकोदर मतिं तवा गदतः क्लीबया वाचा तेजस्ते समदीदिपम्॥
en: Therefore did I, fearful of the direction your inclination might follow from your words which were like those of an eunuch, rekindle your energy, O Vrikodara.

sa: ततोऽर्जुनस्तानामन्त्र्य केशवस्य प्रियः सखा। प्रययौ मातुलं द्रष्टुं नेदमस्तीनि चाब्रवीत्॥
en: Then the Arjuna, the dear friend of Keshava, bidding them farewell, started for seeing his maternal uncle. He said that destruction would soon overtake every thing.

sa: शौनक उवाच पुराणमखिलं तात पिता तेऽधीतवान्पुरा। कच्चित्त्वमपि तत्सर्वमधीषे लौमहर्षणे॥
en: Shaunaka said: Your father read the whole of the Puranas in the days of yore. O Son of Lomaharshana, have you also made them your study?

sa: प्रतिगृह्य तु देवेशस्तुष्टस्तेनास्य कर्मणा। ददौ शक्तिं सुरपतिर्वाक्यं चेदमुवाच ह॥
en: The king of the celestials received the gift and he was exceedingly pleased with his liberality. The lord of the celestials gave him a weapon, saying.

sa: मत्पूर्वाऽपहता भार्या भृगुणाऽनृतकारिणा। सेयं यदि तथा मे त्वं सत्यमाख्यातुमर्हसि॥
en: Bhrigu has appropriated her who was chosen by me as my wife. Tell me truly therefore, whether she is not truly my wife by first choice.

sa: हेतुमर्हसि तं पापं ज्वलिते हव्यवाहने। सर्पसत्रे महाराज त्वरितं तद्विधीयताम्॥
en: It is proper for you to burn the wicked wretch in the blazing fire of a Snake-Sacrifice. Therefore, O king, soon do the needful for it.

sa: को हि शक्रसमान् ज्ञातीनतिक्रम्य महारथान्। अन्येभ्यस्त्राणमाशंसेत् त्वदन्यो भुवि मानवः॥
en: What man, besides yourself in this world, abandoning kinsmen who are mighty carwarriors and each equal to Shakra himself, expects safely with the help of others.

sa: एवं प्रवर्तिते धर्मे पुरा सुचरितेऽनघ। कः क्षत्रमवमन्येत चेतनावान् बहुश्रुतः॥
en: When, O sinless one, duties were thus followed in days of yore what man of cleansed soul and learning is there that would disregard the Kshatriya?

sa: इन्द्रियैः प्राकृतो लोभाद् धर्मं विप्रजहाति यः। कामार्थावनुपायेन लिप्समानो विनश्यति॥
en: The fool, who out of avarice and desire for sexual pleasure, abandons virtue and desires to gain his desire and profit by improper means, is ruined.

sa: मनिमित्तमिदं दुःखं प्राप्तो रामः सुखोचितः। धिग्जीवितं नृशंसस्य मम लोकविगर्हितम्॥
en: It is for me that Rama, although deserving of comfort, has come by this misfortune. Wicked that I am, fie upon my life despised of men!

sa: श्लक्ष्णां वाणी निराबाधां मधुरां पापवर्जिताम्। स्वागतेनाभिभाषन्ते ते नराः स्वर्गगामिनः॥
en: They who utter words which are smooth and sweet and faultless, and who with sincerity welcome all whom they meet with, succeed in ascending to Heaven.

sa: न चैतदिष्टं माता मे यदवोचन्मदन्तरे। नाहमेतेन तुष्टश्च न तद्वचनमाददे॥
en: Whatever my mother has said in relation to me, does not express my wish, I am not satisfied with that, nor do I endorse her speech.

sa: तस्य निर्याणघोषेण राक्षसानां च नर्दताम्। लङ्कायां सर्वभूतानि विनेदुर्विकृतैः स्वरैः॥
en: And at the tumult raised by their exodus, as well as the roars of the Rākşasas, all creatures in Lankā began to cry in preternatural tones.

sa: अथवा ह्रियमाणायाः पथि सिद्धनिषेविते। मन्ये पतितमाया हृदयं प्रेक्ष्य सागरम्॥
en: Or I fancy that while that noble lady was being carried away along the way ranged by Siddhas, she lost her life on beholding the ocean.

sa: सोऽब्रवीद् भरतं हृष्टो निषादाधिपतिर्मुहः। यद्विधं प्रतिपेदे च रामे प्रियहितेऽतिथौ॥
en: Thereat, well pleased, Gulha, the lord of Nişādas, related to Bharata how he had acted in respect of Rāma, his dear guest, studious of his welfare.

sa: अतिदैवं तु तत्तस्य कर्म दृष्ट्वा महर्षयः। विस्मयोत्कम्पहृदया नाम चक्रुर्महाखगे॥
en: The great Rishis, seeing this act which was beyond the powers of the celestials, was filled with wonder and they gave the great bird a name.

sa: ततो गच्छेत राजेन्द्र तीर्थं मेध्यं यथाक्रमम्। सरस्वत्यरुणायाश्च संगमं लोकविश्रुतम्॥
en: O king of kings, one should then go in due order to the celebrated and sacred Tirtha where the Sarasvati and the Aruna are united together.

sa: लोकसंलोडनं घोरं कृतान्तसमदर्शनम्। तमागतमभिप्रेक्ष्य भगवान्कश्यपस्तदा। विदित्वा चास्य संकल्पमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Capable of destroying the three worlds and as fierce-looking as Yama himself. The greatly illustrious Kashyapa, seeing him approach and knowing his intention, thus addressed him,

sa: अव्यक्तात् पूर्वमुत्पन्नो महानात्मा महामतिः। आदिर्गुणानां सर्वेषां प्रथमः सर्ग उच्यते॥
en: From the unmanifest first originated the Great Soul, gifted with great intelligence, the source of all the qualities. That is said to be the first creation.

sa: संजय उवाच द्रौपदेयान् महेष्वासान् सौमदत्तिर्महायशाः। एकैकं पञ्चभिर्विद्ध्वा पुनर्विव्याध सप्तभिः॥
en: Sanjaya said The illustrious son of Somadatta piercing each of those mighty bow men, the sons of Draupadi with five shafts, again pierced them with seven.

sa: तैर्भग्नहदया भूमौ छिन्नमूला इव द्रुमाः॥ निपेतुः शोणितस्नाता विकृता विगतासवः।
en: And with their breasts pierced, they, dripping with blood, deformed and deprived of their lives, lay on the ground like trees whose roots have been severed.

sa: सुषेणश्चात्र धर्मात्मा पुत्रो धर्मस्य वीर्यवान्। सौम्यः सोमात्मजश्चात्र राजन्दधिमुखः कपिः॥
en: The righteous and puissant Sușeņa is the son of Dharma. And the mild monkey, Dadhimukha, O king, is the son of Soma. 1. Righteousness. 2. Moon.

sa: एता विद्याः क्षत्रियाणां राजन् संसिद्धिकारिकाः। अपि गाथामिमां चापि बृहस्पतिरगायत॥
en: Those I have mentioned are, O king, the principle duties for Kshatriyas and lead greatly to their success. Brihaspati, in this matter, sang this verse :

sa: एवमेतानि कर्माणि राजंस्तेन महर्षिणा। कृतानि कानिचित् क्रोधात् प्रतिषिद्धानि कानिचित्।।
en: O king, these were the acts of that great Rishi; some acts he performed from anger and some again he prevented from being done (from anger).

sa: नारद उवाच एवमुक्त्वाभ्यनुज्ञाय पुलस्त्यो भगवानृषिः। प्रीतः प्रीतेन मनसा तत्रैवान्तरधीयत॥
en: Narada said: Having thus spoken with cheerfulness and bidding farewell to him (Bhishma) the exalted Rishi Pulastya with his mind well pleased, disappeared then and there.

sa: विधिवत् पुरुषव्याघ्रः पावकं प्रत्युपाविशत्। प्रमुखे तस्य सैन्यस्य भीतोद्विग्नस्य भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, that best of men in expectation of the approaching fire then sat himself down in front of his terrified and anxious troops.

sa: न चेतयति वो राजा मन्दबुद्धिः सुयोधनः। योऽस्मानाज्ञापयत्येवं वैश्यानिव दिवौकसः॥
en: “Your wicked-minded Duryodhana has but little sense. Or else how could he thus command us who are dwellers of heaven as if we are his servants.

sa: अथवा सैनिकाः केचिदपकुर्युर्युधिष्ठिरम्। तदबुद्धिकृतं कर्म दोषमुत्पादयेच्च वः॥ तस्माद् गच्छन्तु पुरुषाः स्मारणायाप्तकारिणः। न स्वयं तत्र गमनं रोचये तव भारत॥
en: Or some soldiers of yours may do some injury to Yudhishthira and that unpremeditated act may be ascribed to you. O descendant of Bharata, therefore let some faithful men go there to count the cattle and mark the calves. I do not think it is proper for your to go in person.

sa: इष्टं दत्तमधीतं च यज्ञाश्च बहुदक्षिणाः। सर्वमेतदपत्यस्य कलां नार्हन्ति षोडशीम्॥
en: Worship, gift, study, large-Dakshina giving sacrifices, these all are not equal to sixteenth part of that merit which is obtained by the possession of a son.

sa: ययोरन्यतरो भीष्म संक्रुद्धः सचराचराम्। इमां वसुमती कुर्यान्निःशेषामिति मे मतिः॥
en: O Bhishma, it is my opinion that if they are enraged, either of the two can annihilate this earth with all its mobile and immobile creatures.

sa: संतानकवनैः फुल्लैः करवीरवनैरपि। पारिजातवनैश्चैव जपाशोकवनैस्तथा।।२३। कदम्बतरुषण्डैश्च दिव्यैर्मगगणैरपि। दिव्यैः पक्षिगणैश्चैव शुशुभे श्वेतपर्वतः॥ तत्र देवगणा: सर्वे सर्वे देवर्षयस्तथा। मेघतूर्यरवाश्चैव क्षुब्धोदधिसमस्वनाः॥ तन्त्र दिव्याच गन्धर्वा नृत्यन्तेऽप्सररास्तथा! इष्टानां तत्र भूतानां श्रूयते निनदो महान्॥
en: The white mountain was adorned with charming forests full of blossoming Santaka flowers and with forests of Karbira, Parijata, Japa and Ashoka trees and also with wild tracts, overgrown with Kadamba trees; it abounded in innumerable celestials deer and birds. The roaring clouds served the purpose of musical instruments. It sounded like the murmurs of an agitated sea. The celestials, the Gandharvas and the Apsaras began to dance. There rose a loud sound of joy from the merriment of all creatures.

sa: इच्छतां किल नामाहं जीवाम्येषां महीक्षितान्। सोऽहं न गणयाम्येतांस्तृणेनापि नराधिपान्॥
en: Bhishma said Truly am I alive at the pleasure of these rulers of earth. But I do not consider these kings as equal to even straws.

sa: भागार्थं तपसो धातुं तेषां सोमं तथाध्वरे॥ पिपासवो ययुर्देवा: शतक्रतुपुरोगमाः।
en: With Indra at their head, the celestials with the desire of drinking the Soma to receive their respective shares, went to the sacrifices of those Rishis.

sa: अभिवाद्योपसंगृह्य पितामहमथाब्रवीत्। युधिष्ठिर उवाच संशयो द्विपदां श्रेष्ठ ममोत्पन्नः सुदुर्लभः॥
en: Saluted his grandfather by touching his feet and thus spoke to him, “O foremost of all men, a very great doubt has arisen in my mind.

sa: अमर्षेण तु सम्पूर्णो दह्यमानो दिवानिशम्। शुचिशुक्रागमे काले शुष्येत् तोयमिवाल्पकम्॥
en: I have been filled with jealousy, and I am burning day and night. I am being dried up like a shallow tank in the summer season.

sa: एवं स निश्चयं कृत्वा ततो वचनमब्रवीत्। पुनर्गान्धारनृपतिं दह्यमान इवाग्निना॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having been burnt as if by fire and having made the (following) resolve, he (Duryodhana) thus again spoke to the king of Gandhara (Shakuni).

sa: अनुकूलं तथा वच्मि विप्रियं परिवर्जये। अधर्मेणापि संयुक्तं प्रियमाभ्यां करोम्यहम्॥
en: I speak to them only what is agreeable, avoiding all that is unpleasant and disagreeable. I even do that which is not virtuous, to please them.

sa: सर्वरत्नान्युपादाय पार्थिवा वै जनेश्वर। यज्ञे तस्य महाराज पाण्डुपुत्रस्य धीमतः॥
en: O ruler of men, O great king, the monarchs came to the sacrifice of the wise son of Pandu, bringing with them every king of wealth.

sa: आसीद् घोरं वपुस्तस्य बालुकान्तर्हितं महत्॥ दीप्यमानं यथा सूर्यस्तेजसा भरतर्षभ।
en: O foremost of the Bharata race, the monstrous body of that hero lay in the interior of those sands and shone as the sun in splendour.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच अयं बहुधनो राजन् सागरावर्तसम्भवः। मणिर्हारोत्तरः श्रीमान् कनकोत्तमभूषणः॥
en: Yudhishthira said O king, this excellent and most valuable chain of pearls, so beautiful and adorned with gold and procured from the ocean by churning it,

sa: अथैतत् सकलं कच्छपेनोदाहृतं श्रुत्वा तदनन्तरं देवलोकाद् देवरथः प्रादुरासीद् वाचश्चाश्रूयन्तेन्द्रद्युम्नं प्रति प्रस्तुतस्ते स्वर्गो स्वर्गो यथोचितं स्थानं प्रतिपद्यस्व कीर्तिमानस्यव्यग्रो याहीति॥
en: When we were hearing all this from the tortoise, a celestials car came there from the celestials region and an invisible voice was heard which said, "Come and go to the place, you desire to obtain in heaven. Your achievements are great. Therefore cheerfully come to the place (set apart) for you.”

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच रथास्तावन्त एवेमे हेमदण्डाः पताकिनः। हयैर्विनीतैः सम्पन्ना रथिभिश्चित्रयोधिभिः॥
en: Yudhishthira said I have as many cars as elephants, all furnished with golden poles and flat-staffs, and also well trained horses and car-warriors who fight wonderfully.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच मवेक्षमाणां कृपणान् पतीस्तान्। दुःशासनः परुषाण्यप्रियाणि वाक्यान्युवाचामधुराणि चैव॥
en: Vaishampayana said Dushasana spoke many disagreeable and harsh words to Krishna (Draupadi) who was thus piteously weeping and bewailing and casting glances on her helpless husbands.

sa: तावत् स्वपिमि विश्वात्मा सर्वभूतानि मोहयन्। एवं सर्वमहं कालमिहास्से मुनिसत्तम॥
en: I, who am the soul of the universe sleep, overwhelming all creatures in unconsciousness, O foremost of Rishis, then do I stay here for everlasting time,

sa: पाण्डवः सुमहावीर्यो बलेन बलिनां वरः। स काशिराजं समरे सुबाहुमनिवर्तिनम्॥
en: The foremost of all powerful men, the greatly mighty Pandava (Bhima), then vanquished in battle Subahu, the king of Kashi, who never retreated (from the field).

sa: एतच्छ्रुत्वा महान् नादः सभ्यानामुदतिष्ठत। विकर्णं शंसमानानां सौबलं चापि निन्दताम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Hearing these words, a loud uproar rose from those present in the assembly. They all applauded Vikarna and censured the son of Subala (Shakuni).

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा पाण्डवाः सर्वे स्वानि वासांसि भारत। अवकीर्योत्तरीयाणि सभायां समुपाविशन्॥
en: Vaishampayana said O descendant of Bharata, having heard this, the Pandavas took off their upper garments, and throwing them down, they sat (silently) in the Sabha.

sa: स मत्स्यवचनं श्रुत्वा कृपयाभिपरिप्लुतः। मनुर्वैवस्वतोऽगृहणात् तं मत्स्य पाणिना स्वयम्।।१०।
en: Having heard these words of the fish, the Vaivasvata Manu was filled with pity and took out the fish from the water with his own hands.

sa: नकुल उवाच सुतेयं यज्ञसेनस्य द्यूतेऽस्मिन् धृतराष्ट्रजैः। यैर्वाचः श्राविता रूक्षाः स्थितैर्दुर्योधनप्रिये॥ तान् धार्तराष्ट्रान् दुर्वृत्तान् मुमूर्षुन् कालनोदितान्। गमयिष्यामि भूयिष्ठानहं वैवस्वतक्षयम्॥
en: Nakula said I shall certainly send to the abode of Yama all those wicked-minded sons of Dhritarashtra, who being desirous of death and impelled by Fate, and also moved by the wish of doing what would please Duryodhana, have used harsh and insulting words towards this Yajnaseni, (Draupadi) at the gambling match.

sa: निदेशाद् धर्मराजस्य द्रौपद्याः पदवीं चरन्। निर्धार्तराष्ट्रां पृथिवीं कर्तास्मि नचिरादिव॥
en: At the command of the king (Yudhisthira) and remembering the wrongs done to (Draupadi), I shall soon make the earth freed from the sons of Dhritarashtra.

sa: अमोघफलसंकल्पा: सुव्रताः सत्यवादिनः । ब्रह्मभूता नराः पुण्याः पुराणाः कुरुसत्तम॥
en: O the most exalted of the Kurus, the primary men had all their desires gratified, were given to virtuous deeds and were truthful, godly and pure.

sa: यथार्ह वन्दनाश्लेषान् कृत्वा गन्तुमियेष सा। ततो निनादः सुमहान् पाण्डवान्तःपुरेऽभवत्॥
en: Saluting and embracing every one of them as each deserved, she desired to go away. Thereupon loud lamentations rose within the inner apartments of the Pandavas.

sa: अत्र ते कथयिष्यामि तदिहैकमनाः शृणु। यथेहामुत्र च नरः सुखदुःखमुपाश्नुते॥
en: I will now narrate to you how men experience pleasure and pain in this world and in the next. Listen to me with an undivided attention.

sa: भवान् दैवतदैत्यानामृषीणां च महात्मनाम्। राजर्षीणां च सर्वेषां चरितज्ञः पुरातनः॥
en: “You are ancient in age and are therefore conversant with the events relating to all the gods, the demons, the high-souled sages and the royal saints.

sa: अयोनिजां रूपवती कुले जातां विभावसोः। को नु तां सर्वधर्मज्ञां परिभूय यशस्विनीम्॥ पर्यानयेत् सभामध्ये विना दुर्दूतदेविनम्। स्त्रीधर्मिणी वरारोहा शोणितेन परिप्लुता॥
en: Who else than that false player at dice (Duryodhana) could bring into the Sabha with insults the daughter of Drupada, possessing beauty and intelligence, being conversant with every rule of morality and duty, and sprung not from any woman's womb but from the sacred fire. That beautiful lady was in her season covered with blood.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच एवं द्यूतजिताः पार्थाः कोपिताश्च दुरात्मभिः। धार्तराष्ट्र: सहामात्यैनिकृत्या द्विजसत्तम॥ श्राविता: परुषा वाचः सृजद्भिर्वैरमुत्तमम्। किमकुर्वत कौरव्य मम पूर्वपितामहाः॥
en: Janamejaya said : O best of Brahmanas, having been deceitfully defeated at dice by the sons of Dhritarashtra with their counsellors and having been provoked by the wicked-minded ones (the Kuru princes), who thus brought about a fearful hostility by addressing them in cruel words, what did the Kurus, my grandsires do?

sa: मातरं चैव शोचामि कृपणां पुत्रगृद्धिनीम्। यास्माकं नित्यमाशास्ते महत्त्वमधिकं परैः॥
en: And I mourn for my poor mother fond of her children, who is always desirous of our greatness superior to that ever attained by our enemies.

sa: सोऽङ्कमानीय विदुरं मूर्धन्याघ्राय चैव ह। क्षम्यतामिति चोवाच यदुक्तोऽसि मयानघ॥
en: He then took Vidura on his lap and smelt his head. He said, "O sinless one, forgive me for the words that I spoke to you.

sa: सुह्यानामधिपं चैव ये च सागरवासिनः। सर्वान् म्लेच्छगणांश्चैव विजिग्ये भरतर्षभः॥
en: The ruler of the Suhamas and also the kings that lived on the sea coast, the best of the Bharata race (Bhima) subjugated all the Mlecchas.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच इत्येवमुक्त्वा मैत्रेयः प्रातिष्ठत यथाऽऽगतम्। किर्मीरवधसंविग्नो बहिर्दुर्योधनो ययौ॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having said this, Maitreya went away whence he came. Duryodhana (also) went away much agitated by the thought of the death of Kirmira.

sa: अर्जुनार्जुन मा युक्ष्व दिव्यान्यस्त्राणि भारत। नैतानि निरधिष्ठाने प्रयुज्यन्ते कथंचन॥
en: "O Arjuna, O Bharata, forebear discharging these celestials weapons. These (weapons) ought, by no means, to be hurled where there is no object to hit at.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच पाण्डवोधर्मराजोऽहं यदि ते श्रोत्रमागतः। सहितो भ्रातृभिः सर्वैर्भीमसेनार्जुनादिभिः॥ हृतराज्यो वने वासं वस्तुं कृतमतिस्ततः। वनमभ्यागतो घोरमिदं तव परिग्रहम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said : I am the son of Pandu, Dharmaraja (Yudhishthira); you may have heard of me. Deprived of my kingdom, I with my brothers, Bhima, Arjuna and others have come in my wanderings to this fearful forest which is your dominion. I desire to pass the period of my exile here.

sa: ततोऽहमपि कौरव्य रोषव्याकुलमानस:। निश्चित्य मनसा राजन् वधायास्य मनो दधे॥
en: Thereupon, O descendant of Kuru, O king, having my mind agitated by wrath and resolving in my mind to kill him, I determind to do it.

sa: दारुकस्य सुतस्तत्र बाणवेगमचिन्तयन्। भूय एव महाबाहो प्रययावपसव्यतः॥ ततो बाणान् बहुविधान् पुनरेव स सौभराट्। मुमोच तनये वीर मम रुक्मिणिनन्दने॥ तानप्राप्ताञ्छितैर्बाणैश्चिच्छेद परवीरहा। रौक्मिणेयः स्मितं कृत्वा दर्शयन् हस्तलाघवम्॥ छिन्नान् दृष्ट्वा तु तान् बाणान् प्रद्युम्नेन च सौभराट्। आसुरीं दारुणीं मायामास्थाय व्यसृजच्छरान्॥
en: O mighty-armed hero, without taking any notice of the force of those arrows the son of Daruka, continued to lead the chariot round the (Shalva's) army as he was doing (from the start). O hero, thereupon the king Shalva, again discharged at my son, the son born of Rukmani, a shower of various kinds of weapons. But that slayer of hostile heroes, the son of Rukmani, smilingly showed the lightness of his hand and cut off all those weapons before they reached him. Secing all his weapons cut down, the Saubha king, taking recourse of the terrible illusion, natural to the Asuras, poured a shower of weapons.

sa: देवराजं सहस्राक्षमुपातिष्ठं कृताञ्जलिः। ददावर्धासनं प्रीतः शक्रो मे ददतां वरः॥
en: I stood before the hundred-eyed king of the gods with joined hands. And Sakra, the best of the liberal-handed, gladly offered to me half his seat.

sa: ते निकृत्तभुजस्कन्धाः कवन्धाकृतिदर्शनाः। नदन्तो भैरवान् नादान् निपतन्ति स्म दानवाः॥
en: Having lost their arms and necks and having appeared like Kabandhas (a sort of headless ghosts), the Danavas fell (down into the sea) with fearful cries.

sa: अथ मां पुरुषः कश्चिद् द्वारकानिलयोऽब्रवीत्। त्वरिता रथमभ्येत्य सौहृदादिव भारत॥ आहुकस्य वचो वीर तस्यैव परिचारकः। विषण्णः सन्नकण्ठेन तन्निबोध युधिष्ठिर॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, (at this time) a certain person quickly came to my car and addressed me like a friend. O hero, O Yudhishthira, know he appeared (to me) to be a servant of Ahuka and he delivered to me a message from his (Ahuka) in a sad and choked voice.

sa: सोऽहं पर्वतवर्षेण वध्यमानः पुनः पुनः। वल्मीक इव राजेन्द्र पर्वतोपचितोऽभवम्॥
en: O king of kings, he tried to kill me again and again by showers of rocks; and I looked like an ant-hill covered with those rocks.

sa: द्विधा कृतं ततः सौभं सुदर्शनबलाद्धतम्। महेश्वरशरोद्भूतं पपात त्रिपुरं यथा।॥
en: Cut in twain by the force of the Sudarshana, the Saubha fell like the city of Tripura shaken by the weapon of the great God (Shiva).

sa: तस्मिन् निपतिते सौभे चक्रमागात् करं मम। पुनश्चादाय वेगेन शाल्वायेत्हमब्रुवम्॥
en: When the Saubha fell, the discuss came (back) to my hand. Taking it up, I once more hurled it with great, force, saying “Go to Shalva."

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच कथं शप्तोऽसि भगवन्नगस्त्येन महात्मना। श्रोतुमिच्छाम्यहं देव तवैतच्छापकारणम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said : O lord, what were you cursed by the nobleminded Agastya for? O God, I am desirous of hearing the cause of that imprecation.

sa: एकेन बहवः सङ्खये मानुषेण पराजिताः। प्राप्य वैश्रवणावासं किं वक्ष्यथधनेश्वरम्॥
en: "Going to the abode of Vaisravana, how would you tell the lord of wealth that vast numbers (of Yakshas) have been slain by a single man."

sa: तस्माद् बलवता चैव दुर्बलेन च नित्यदा। क्षन्तव्यं पुरुषेणाहुरापत्स्वपि विजानता॥
en: For this, it is said that a wise man whether he be strong or weak, should always forgive his persecutor, even if he is in difficulty.

sa: कालोऽयं दारुणः प्राप्तो भरतानामभूतये। निश्चितं मे सदैवैतत् पुरस्तादपि भाविनि॥
en: A dreadful time has set in to bring about the misfortune of the Bharatas; from some time before this has been settled conclusion, O fair damsel.

sa: न्यवारयत् तौ प्रहसन् कुन्तीपुत्रो वृकोदरः। शक्तोऽहं राक्षसस्येति प्रेक्षध्वमिति चाब्रवीत्॥
en: The son of Kunti, Vrikodara (Bhima), smiled and asked them to stop. He spoke to them, “Behold, I am more than a match for this (Rakshasa).

sa: यत्रधीमानवेक्षेत श्रेयांसं बहुभिर्गुणैः। साम्नैवार्थं ततो लिप्सेत् कर्म चास्मै प्रयोजयेत्॥
en: If an intelligent man finds his enemy superior to him in many qualities he should accomplish his object by the arts of conciliation and proper appliances.

sa: उक्तस्त्वेवं तया राजा यमाविदमथाब्रवीत्। गच्छाम सहितास्तूर्णं येन यातो वृकोदरः॥
en: “We must all soon go along the path Vrikodara (Bhima) has gone. Let the Rakshasas carry all those Brahmanas who are fatigued and who are weak.

sa: अतिबेलं हि योऽर्थार्थी नेतरावनुतिष्ठति। स वध्यः सर्वभूतानां ब्रह्महेव जुगुप्सितः॥
en: He, again, who pursues Artha (profit or wealth) too much without pursuing Dharma (virtue) and Kama (pleasure) deserves to be censured and killed by all creatures.

sa: धार्मिकान्धर्मकार्येषु अर्थकार्येषु पण्डितान्। स्त्रीषु क्लीबान् नियुञ्जीत क्रूरान् क्रूरेषु कर्ममु॥
en: In religious matters pious men, in the matters of gain learned men, in guarding woman eunuchs and in all crooked affairs crooked men should be employed.

sa: ईतयो व्याधयस्तन्द्री दोषाः क्रोधादयस्तथा। उपद्रवाः प्रवर्तन्ते आधयः क्षुद्भयं तथा॥
en: Then Ati (excessive rain), draught, rats, locusts, birds and king, diseases, lassitude, anger, deformities, natural calamities, anguish and fear of famine take possession of the world.

sa: उवाच श्लक्ष्णया वाचा हनूमन्तं कपीश्वरम्। मयाधन्यतरो नास्ति यदार्यं हृष्टवानहम्॥
en: He spoke in mild words to the monkey chief, Hanuman, "None is more fortunate than I am for I have been able to see my brother.

sa: सीताप्रसादाच्च सदा मामिहस्थमरिदम। उपतिष्ठन्ति दिव्या हि भोगा भीम यथेप्सिताः॥
en: O chastiser of foes, O Bhima, through the grace of Sita, all excellent objects of enjoyments are supplied to me who always live in this place.

sa: सावज्ञमथ वामेन स्मयञ्जग्राह पाणिना। न चाशकच्चालयितुं भीमः पुच्छं महाकपेः॥
en: Therefore with a smile, Bhima carelessly took hold of the tail with his left hand, but he could not move that tail of the mighty monkey.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तत्र ते पुरुषव्याघ्राः परमं शौचमास्थिताः। षड्रात्रमवसन् वीराधनंजयदिदृक्षवः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : There lived those foremost of men, those heroes, for six nights, leading a highly pure life with the expectation of seeing Dhananjaya (Arjuna).

sa: अस्माल्लोकाद् देवलोकं पाकशासनशासनात्। आरोह त्वं मया साधु लब्धास्त्रः पुनरेष्यसि॥
en: By the command of the chastiser of Paka ascend with me from this region to that of the celestials and having obtained the weapon return therefrom.

sa: भ्रक्षेपालापमाधुपैः कान्त्या सौम्यतया पे च। शशिनं वक्त्रचन्द्रेण साऽऽह्वयन्तीव गच्छति॥
en: With her beauty, grace and the charm of the motions of her eye-brows, with her soft accents and moon-like face, she walked on defying the moon.

sa: उर्वश्युवाच तव पित्राभ्यनुज्ञातां स्वयं च गृहमागताम्। यस्मान्मां नाभिनन्देथाः कामबाणवशंगताम्॥ तस्मात् त्वं नर्तनः पार्थ स्त्रीमध्ये मानवर्जितः। अपुमानिति विख्यातः षण्ढवद् विचरिष्यसि॥
en: Urvashi said: As you insult a woman who come to you at the command of your father and at her own desire, (a woman) who is pierced with the arrows of the god of love. O Partha, you shall have to live among women, losing all respect becoming a dancer and being deprived of manhood.

sa: एतदर्थमहं भद्रे प्रेषितः सुरसत्तमैः। एतच्छ्रुत्वा शुभे बुद्धिं प्रकुरुष्व यथेच्छसि॥
en: O respected one, I have been sent by the illustrious gods on this errand. O lucky one, form your opinion by hearing this, as you please.

sa: एषा शम्येकपत्रा या सरकं चैतदुत्तमम्। पश्य रामह्रदानेतान् पश्य नारायणाश्रमम्॥
en: Here is the Shami tree which has but one; single leaf; this is an excellent work. Behold the lake of Rama and the hermitage of Narayana.

sa: तमपश्यंस्तथाऽऽयानं लोकपाला महेश्वराः। दृष्ट्वा चैनं ततोऽपृच्छन् वृत्तान्तं सर्वमेव तम्॥
en: Thereupon the great lords, who are the guardians of the world, seeing him approach, to them, inquired of him about all that had taken place there.

sa: ततः पौरजनाः सर्वे मन्त्रिभिः सह भारत। राजानं द्रष्टुमागच्छन् निवारयितुमातुरम्॥
en: Thereupon, O Bharata, all the inhabitants of the city with the ministers came to see the troubled prince and also to dissuade him (from the play).

sa: इह नित्यशया देवाः पितरश्च महर्षिभिः। अर्चीकपर्वते तेपुस्तान् यजस्व युधिष्ठिर।॥
en: O Yudhishthira, here did the Pitris, the celestials and the great Rishis always lie down. They all performed asceticism on the Archika mountain. Perform sacrifice here.

sa: यथा च पुष्करस्याक्षाः पतन्ति वशवर्तिनः। तथा विपर्ययश्चापि नलस्याक्षेषु दृश्यते॥
en: As the dice fall in accordance with the commands of Pushkara, so it is seen they are adverse to the interests of Nala in the play.

sa: एष शर्यातियज्ञस्य देशस्तात प्रकाशते। साक्षाद् यत्रापिबत् सोममश्विभ्यां सह कौशिकः॥
en: O child, this is the place where Sharyati performed his sacrifice. Kaushika (Indra) with Ashvins appeared here in their visible forms and drank the Soma (juice).

sa: ते वयं दमयन्त्यर्थे चरामः पृथिवीमिमाम्। सेयमासादिताः बाला तव पुत्रनिवेशने॥
en: We (the Brahmanas) are roving over the whole world for the sake of Damayanti, which lady is at last discovered in the palace of your son.

sa: स मलेनापकृष्टेन पिप्लुस्तस्या व्यरोचत। दमयन्त्या यथा व्यभ्रे नभसीव निशाकरः॥
en: The mole of Damayanti, having been cleared of the bad dust, became conspicuous like the moon, which appears in the sky when the clouds are dispersed.

sa: महाह्रदं समासाद्य काश्यपस्तपसि स्थितः। दीर्घकालं परिश्रान्त ऋषिः स देवसम्मितः॥
en: Going to the great lake, the son of Kashyapa engaged himself in great austerities. And that celestials-like Rishi became fatigued after a long period of time.

sa: कुशाकारेव दुर्वेयं संस्तीर्णेव च भूरियम्। यूपप्रकारा बहवो वृक्षाश्चेमे विशाम्पते॥
en: O king, this grass is like the Kusha (grass), the whole ground is over-spread with the sacred grass. Many trees here look like the sacrificial stakes.

sa: दमयन्ती वदेदेतत् कुर्याद् दुःखेन मोहिता। अस्मदर्थे भवेद् वायमुपायश्चिन्तितो महान्॥
en: He thought “It may be that Damayanti, afflicted by sorrow, does this; or, perhaps, by doing this, she has conceived a great policy for my sake.

sa: पूरणार्थं समुद्रस्य मन्त्रयित्वा पुनः पुनः। ऊचुः प्राञ्जलय: सर्वे सागरस्याभिपूरणम्॥
en: Having again and again held consultations in order to fill up again the ocean, they thus spoke with joined hands about the refilling of the ocean.

sa: स शरीरं समुत्सृज्य स्वान्यस्थीनि प्रदास्यति। तस्यास्थिभिर्महाघोरं वज्रं संस्क्रियतां दृढम्॥
en: Giving up his body, he will give his bones to you. With those bones make a greatly fearful and strong weapon (to be called) Vajra (thunder).

sa: लेभिरे पितरश्चास्य लोकान् राजन् यथेप्सितान्। तत अर्ध्वमयं ख्यातस्त्वगस्त्यस्याश्रमो भुवि॥
en: O king, by this his ancestors obtained the region they desired. From that time this place has become famous on earth as the hermitage of Agastya.

sa: शून्यामिव प्रपश्यामि तत्र तत्र महीमिमाम्। बह्लाश्चर्यमिदं चापि वनं कुसुमितदुमम्॥
en: Wherever I cast my eyes, I see this earth as if it is empty. This forest, with its blossoming trees and with its so many wonders.

sa: असंशयं प्रजाहेतोर्भार्यां पतिरविन्दत। या तु त्वयि मम प्रीतिस्तामृषे कर्तुमर्हसि॥
en: "The husband certainly narries a wife for the purpose of offspring. But O Rishi, you should show towards me that love which I bear for you.

sa: कुमारिकाणां शक्रस्य तीर्थं सिद्धनिषेवितम्। तत्र स्नात्वा नरः क्षिप्रं स्वर्गलोकमवाप्नुयात्॥
en: Then is the Tirtha, called Kumariak of Sakra (Indra), frequented by the Siddhas. O foremost of men, bathing there one obtains the region of Sakra (Indra).

sa: ततो गच्छेतधर्मज्ञ विमलं तीर्थमुत्तमम्। अद्यापि यत्र दृश्यन्ते मत्स्याः सौवर्णराजताः॥
en: O virtuous man, one should then go to that excellent Tirtha called Simala, where even today are to be seen fishes of silver and golden colour.

sa: शिवोद्भेदे नरः स्नात्वा गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्। नागोद्भेदे नरः स्नात्वा नागलोकमवाप्नुयात्॥
en: Bathing in Sivodveda a man obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine. Bathing in Nagaveda a man goes to the region of the Nagas.

sa: गङ्गायाश्च नरश्रेष्ठ सरस्वत्याश्च संगमे। स्नात्वाश्वमेधं प्राप्नोति स्वर्गलोकं च गच्छति॥
en: O foremost of men, bathing at the confluence of the Ganges and the Sarasvati one obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha and goes to the celestials region.

sa: ब्रह्मावर्तं ततो गच्छेद् ब्रह्मचारी समाहितः। अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति सोमलोकं च गच्छति॥
en: One should then go with concentrated mind and with Brahmacharya life to Brahmavarta. He obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha and goes to the region of Soma.

sa: अगस्त्यस्य तु राजेन्द्र तत्राश्रमवरो नृप। तत् तथा तापसारण्यं तापसैरुपशोभितम्॥
en: O king of kings, O ruler, there is that foremost of hermitages of Agastya and also the forest called Tapasa graced by the presence of ascetics.

sa: इष्टा वाचः प्रविष्टस्य दक्षिणाः प्रविविक्षतः। पश्चात् संधारयन्त्यर्थमग्रे च प्रतिषेधिका:॥
en: Those who wishing to enter into the ranks of the foe, utter even kind words and those who warn the foe before striking always obtain victory.

sa: ततो नृपं पराजित्य पार्षतः परवीरहा। न्यहनत् तावकं सैन्यं वज्रपाणिरिवासुरान्॥
en: Then vanquishing the Kuru king, Prishata's son that slayer of hostile heroes, began to slaughter your troops like the wielder of the thunder-bolt slaying the Asuras.

sa: नैतादृशं दृष्टपूर्वे कुबेरसदनेष्वपि। धनं च पूर्यमाणं नः किं पुनर्मनुजेष्विति॥
en: We have not seen such vast treasures even in the mansion of Kubera (the Plutus of Hindu mythology), what to speak of the treasures of men?

sa: द्रोणेन व्याहते त्वेवं संशप्तकगणाः पुनः। आह्वयन्नर्जुनं संख्ये दक्षिणामभितो दिशम्॥
en: After Drona had spoken in the above manner, the host of the Samshaptakas, once more challenging Arjuna led him to the southern part of the field.

sa: ततः शङ्खमुपाध्याय त्वरयन् वाजिनः स्वयम्। इतस्ततस्तान् रचयन् द्रोणश्चरति वेगितः॥
en: Then blowing his conch and urging his steeds to full speed, Drona began to move hither and thither with great celerity, arranging his troops in order.

sa: आरावं परमं कृत्वा वध्यमानाः किरीटिना। निपेतुरनिशं भूमौ छिन्नपक्षा इवाद्रयः॥
en: Uttering fierce roars when they were being slaughtered by the diadem-decked Arjuna, they began to fall incessantly on the ground like mountains having their wings cut-off.

sa: तं निवार्य शरौघेण शक्रसूनुर्महारथः। सुशर्मणो रणे योद्धान् प्राहिणोद् यमसादनम्॥
en: Baffling those arrows with his showers of arrows, that mighty car-warrior, the son of Shakra, dispatched the warriors that supported Susharma to the mansion of Death.

sa: आददानो महाबाहुः कार्मुकं तालसंनिभम्। ततो मय्याददानं त राममेव न्यवारयन्॥
en: The one of long arms took up his bow which was strong and also took up an arrow; but I withstood Rama equipped as he was.

sa: कथं चातिरथस्तेन पाञ्चाल्येन शिखण्डिना। भीष्मो विनिहतो युद्धे देवैरपि दुरासदः॥
en: How could Bhishma, who was an Atiratha and who could not be resisted even by the celestial be killed in battle by the Panchala Prince Shikhandin?

sa: पाण्डवानां यशस्कामः परं कर्म करिष्यति। अनुरक्तश्च शूरच रथोऽयमपरो महान्।॥
en: Being desirous of the fame of the sons of Pandu he will do great deeds. Here is another great Ratha, a hero who is their follower.

sa: संजय उवाच शिखण्डी तु रणे भीष्ममासाद्य पुरुषर्षभम्। दशभिर्निशितैर्भल्लैराजघान स्तनान्तरे॥
en: Sanjaya said Then, O foremost of men, Shikhandin having encountered Bhishma in battle, pierced the latter on his breast with ten broad-headed shafts of great sharpness.

sa: धर्मान् संस्थापयामासुर्युद्धानां भरतर्षभ। निवृत्ते विहिते युद्धे स्यात् प्रीतिर्नः परस्परम्॥
en: (Such as) men equally situated should only fight with one another with all fairness. If having fought with fairness, the combatants withdraw, that would be preferred.

sa: यदा भूतपृथग्भावमेकस्थमनुपश्यति। तत एव च विस्तारं ब्रह्म सम्पद्यते तदा।॥
en: When one sees the various entities existing in One, and the birth of every thing from that one, he is then said to attain to Brahma.

sa: ततो भीष्मः कुरुश्रेष्ठ सिंहवद् विनदन् मुहुः। धनंजयरथं शीघ्रं शरवर्षैरवाकिरत्॥
en: Then that foremost of Kuru warriors Bhishma again and again roared like a lion. He then covered the car of Dhananjaya with a shower of arrows.

sa: रजसि प्रलयं गत्वा कर्मसङ्गिषु जायते। तथा प्रलीनस्तमसि मूढयोनिषु जायते॥
en: Dying, when Raja prevails, he goes among those who are attached to works. Dying in Tama he is born in the womb that produces ignorant men.

sa: सैन्धवस्य महाराज पुत्रो राजा जयद्रथः। स पुत्रगृद्धिनः पार्थान् सहसैन्यानवारयत्॥
en: Then, O monarch, Jayadratha the royal son of the Sindhu king, checked the Parthas backed by their troops, when they tried to rescue their son (Abhimanyu).

sa: पार्षतः शरजालेन क्षिप्रं प्रच्छाद्य दुर्मुखम्। भारद्वाजं शरौघेण महता समवारयत्॥
en: The son of Prishata, speedily covering Durmukha with his net-work of arrows, checked the career of the son of Bharadvaja with a thick shower of shafts.

sa: असुरसुरमनुष्या: पक्षिणो वोरगा वा पितृजनिचरा वा ब्रह्मदेवर्षयो वा। चरमचरमपीदं यत्परं चापि तस्मात् तदपि ममरिपुं तं रक्षितुं नैव शक्ताः॥
en: Asuras and the celestials, mortals, winged creatures, reptiles or ancestral manes, rangers of the night, Brahmanical or celestials sages, the mobile and immobile things and beings and what other things there may be on the face of the earth, even all these will not be able to protect that foe of mine.

sa: व्यूह भीष्मेण चाभेद्यं कल्पितं प्रेक्ष्य पाण्डवः। अभेद्यमिव सम्प्रेक्ष्य विवर्णोऽर्जुनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Having seen the impenetrable Vyuha formed by Bhishma and having concluded it to be really impenetrable, the king became pale and he thus spoke to Arjuna.

sa: तामापतन्ती सहसा शक्तिं कनकभूषिताम्। त्रिधा चिच्छेद समरे भारद्वाजो हसन्निव॥
en: Thereupon the son of Bharadvaja smilingly cut down into three parts that dart adorned with gold and gems that was coming towards him with great force.

sa: ततः क्रोधसमाविष्टो निःश्वसत्रिव पन्नगः। संशयं परमं प्राप्तः पुत्रस्ते भरतर्षभ॥
en: Thereafter your son possessed with rage, and breathing like a snake was involved in a very hazardous situation in that battle, O foremost of the Bharatas.

sa: ध्रुवं हि युद्धे मरणं शूराणामनिवर्तिनाम्। गतः पुण्यकृतां लोकानभिमन्यु संशयः॥
en: Undoubtedly Abhimanyu has gone to the regions of those who perform pious deeds; and, O foremost of the Bharatas, even this is coveted by all heroes.

sa: सुकुमारं महेष्वासं वासवस्यात्मजात्मजम्। सदा मम प्रियं ब्रूत कथमायोधने हतः॥
en: Tell me about Abhimanyu, the grandson of Indra, the great archer, delicate body youth and always dear to me. How was he slaughtered in the battle.

sa: तस्मादहं गृह्य रथाङ्गमुग्रं प्राणं हरिष्यामि महाव्रतस्य॥ निहत्य भीष्मं सगणं तथाऽऽजौ द्रोणं च शेनेय रथप्रवीरौ। प्रीतिं करिष्यामि धनंजयस्य राज्ञश्च भीमस्य तथाऽिश्वनोच॥ स्तत्पक्षिणो ये च नरेन्द्रमुख्याः। राज्येन राजानमजातशत्रु सम्पादयिष्याम्यहमद्य हृष्टः॥
en: Therefore taking up my fearful discus I shall (today) kill Bhishma of rigid vows. O grandson of Shini, killing in battle these two foremost of car-warriors, namely Bhishma and Drona with all their followers, I shall gladden the heart of Dhananjaya and the king (Yudhishthira) and also of Bhima and the twin Ashvins. Killing all the sons of Dhritarashtra and all those foremost of kings who have taken their side, I will with great joy secure a kingdom today for Ajatashatru.”

sa: ततोऽभिपूज्य मनसा कृष्णं शर्वं च पाण्डवः। इच्छाम्यहं दिव्यमस्त्रमित्यभाषत शङ्करम्॥
en: Thereafter that son of Pandu having worshipped in his mind both Sharva and Krishna, said unto the gold Sankara-'I desire to have the celestial weapon (Pasupata)!'

sa: न चैवं पाण्डवेयानां कश्चिच्छक्नोति वीक्षितुम्। विशिखानेव पश्यन्ति भीष्मचापच्युतान् बहून्॥
en: There was none amongst the Pandavas who was able even to look at him. What they all saw were only innumerable arrows shot from his bow.

sa: यत्र चायं महाराज पक्षिराट् पतगोत्तमः। यक्षानुगा महाराज धनिनः प्रियदर्शनाः॥
en: o king, there lives the king of birds, Garuda. O king, the people there are all handsome and rich, they are all followers of the Yakshas.

sa: प्रकृति पुरुषं चैव विद्ध्यनादी उभावपि। विकारांश्च गुणांश्चैव विद्धि प्रकृतिसम्भवान्।॥
en: Know that Prakriti and Purusha are both without beginnings; and know all modifications (of matter) and all qualities (pleasures and pain &c.) spring from Prakriti (Nature).

sa: ततः प्रसादयामासुर्यक्षा वैश्रवणं किला स्थूणस्यार्थं कुरुष्वान्तं शापस्येति पुनः पुनः॥
en: The Yakshas then began to appease (the anger of) Vaishravana, for the sake of Sthuna Karna, (saying) "set a limit to your course" again and again.

sa: तत् सुवर्णमपर्यन्तं राजर्षिः कुरुजाङ्गले। ईजानो वितते यज्ञे ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ह्यमन्यत॥
en: That royal sage, having performed a sacrifice in Kurujangala, gave away that unlimited quantity of gold to the Brahmanas, even before the accomplishment of that sacrifice.

sa: ध्वजिनीं धार्तराष्ट्राणां दीनशत्रुरदीनवत्। प्रत्युद्ययौ स सौभद्रस्तेजसा च बलेन च॥
en: Then that chastiser of foes, the son of Subhadra, depending on his own prowess and might, advanced with under-pressed heart against the army of the Kurus.

sa: रुक्मदण्डां महाशक्ति जग्राहाग्निशिखोपमाम्। चिक्षेप तां राक्षसस्य तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत्॥
en: Took up a lance furnished with a golden staff and blazing like the flames of fire, and then hurled it at the Rakshasa saying 'Stay' 'Stay.'

sa: अद्रिसारमयीं गुर्वी प्रगृह्य महतीं गदाम्। अभ्यधावद् गजानीकं व्यादितास्य इवान्तकः॥
en: Grasping a mighty and heavy mace made of the essence of adamant, Bhimasena charged that division of elephants, like Death himself with his mouth wide open.

sa: तथा बृहद्बलं हन्ता सौभद्रो व्यचरद् रणे। व्यष्टम्भयन्महेष्वासो योधास्तव शराम्बुभिः॥
en: Thereafter having slain Brihadbala in battle, Subhadra's son careered through the field, the paralysed the mighty car-warriors of your army with a downpour of arrowy showers.

sa: दधार सुप्रतीकोऽपि वेलेव मकरालयम्। वारितं प्रेक्ष्य नागेन्द्रं दशार्णस्य महात्मनः॥
en: Namely Supratika withstood it like the banks of the ocean resisting its surging waves. Beholding the excellent elephant of the highsouled ruler of Dasharna thus checked,

sa: समुद्र इव सिन्धूनां ज्योतिषामिव भास्करः। सत्यस्य च यथा सन्तो बीजानामिव चोर्वरा॥ पर्जन्य इव भूतानां प्रतिष्ठा सुहृदां भव। बान्धवास्त्वानुजीवन्तु सहस्राक्षमिवामराः॥
en: May you be the refuge of your friends, even as the ocean is the refuge of the rivers, the sun of the other planets, the pious of the truth, fertile soil of the seeds and Parjanya of the created beings. May your relations depend on you even as the immortals depend upon the thousand-eyed Indra.

sa: यो भुक्त्वेमां वसुमती म्लेच्छाटविकवर्जिताम्। यस्मै ववर्ष पर्जन्यो हिरण्यं परिवत्सरान्॥
en: During his time of rule, the earth was freed from the depredation of Mlecchas and the forest-thieves and the Parjanya showered gold throughout the whole year.

sa: हताश्वात् तु रथात् तूर्णनवतीर्य महाभुजः। आरुरोह रथं भ्रातुरन्यच्च धनुराददे॥
en: Meanwhile the mighty-armed Vrishaka alighting from his chariot of which the horses were slain, ascended the car of his brother with agility and grasped another bow.

sa: छत्रच्छायासमुचितं तस्य तद् वदनं शुभम्॥ नूनमद्य रजोध्वस्तं रणरेणुः करिष्यति।
en: That auspicious and charming countenances of his, worthy of being shaded by umbrellas. Shall today be soiled with the dust rising from the field of battle.

sa: कोशसंचयवाहांश्च कोष्ठागारं तथैव च। गजानीकेन संगृह्य शनैः प्रायाद् युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: And with the animals carrying his treasures, and his granaries and uniting all these by means of an army of elephants, king Yudhishthira slowly marched forward.

sa: तमन्वयात् सत्यधृतिः सौचित्तियुद्धदुर्मदः। श्रेणिमान् वसुदानश्च पुत्रः काश्यस्य वा विभुः॥
en: Him (Yudhishthira) followed Suchitta, an unswerving adherent of truth, and who was invincible in battle, and Shrenimat and Vasudeva, and Vibhu, the son of the Kashis.

sa: पाञ्चाल्यं तु महाबाहो नाहं हन्यां शिखण्डिनम्। उद्यतेषुमथो दृष्ट्वा प्रतियुध्यन्तमाहवे॥
en: But, O you of long arms, I shall not slay Shikhandin, the prince of Panchala even though I see him advancing against me ready to strike.

sa: गजा विंशतिसाहस्रा ईषादन्ताः प्रहारिणः। कुलीना भिन्नकरटा मेघा इव विसर्पिणः॥
en: And twenty thousand elephants who smote with their tusks resembling plowshares all of good breed, and with spit temples and moving about like masses of clouds.

sa: व्यास उवाच प्रादुरासीत् ततः पुत्रः सृञ्जयस्याद्भुतप्रभः। प्रसन्नेनर्षिणा दत्तः कुबेरतनयोपमः॥
en: Vyasa said Then the son of Srinjaya of wonderful splendour, resembling the son of Kubera, appeared there, bestowed on his bereaved father, by the qualified sage.

sa: ततोऽहं तं नमस्कृत्य रथमारुह्य सत्वरः। प्राध्यापयं रणे शङ्ख पुनर्हेमपरिष्कृतम्॥
en: Then did I, after saluting him, quickly mount my chariot and again blew loudly my conch in the field of battle, a conch set with gold.

sa: यज्ञार्थात् कर्मणोऽन्यत्र लोकोऽयं कर्मबन्धनः। तदर्थं कर्म कौन्तेय मुक्तसङ्गः समाचर॥
en: The world is bound in (by the laws) of action, except the action of Sacrifice. Therefore, O son of Kunti, being free from attachment, perform actions.

sa: प्रादुश्चक्रे महामायां तामसी परतापनाम्। ततस्ते तमसा सर्वे वृताश्चासन् महीपते॥
en: That afflicter of enemies, created a veil of impenetrable darkness through his illusive prowess. Then O ruler of men, every body was covered by the gloom;

sa: तत्राक्रन्दो महानासीत् तावकानां महात्मनाम्। वध्यतां समरे राजन् पार्षतेन महात्मना॥
en: Then, O monarch, a loud cry of agony was set up by your high souled warriors as they were slain by the illustrious son of Prishata.

sa: उदीर्णान् पार्थिवान् सर्वान् साश्वान् सरथकुञ्जरान्। असम्भ्रमं भीमसेनो गदया समवारयत्॥
en: Undauntedly did Bhimasena check with his mace, the rulers of men who, excited with wrath, had been advancing towards him, on their steeds, chariots and Bhimasena.

sa: तस्य शक्तिं रणे कार्णिभृत्यो?रां स्वसामिव। प्रेषयामास संक्रुद्धो दुर्योधनरथं प्रति॥
en: Then in that battle, Krishna's nephew, inflamed with wrath, let go at the car of Duryodhana his lance that looked like the sister of Death himself.

sa: दूरेण ह्यवरं कर्म बुद्धियोगाद् धनंजय। बुद्धौ शरणमन्विच्छ कृपणाः फलहेतवः॥
en: Religious rites, O Dhananjaya, is far inferior to devotion; therefore take shelter in devotion. The men who look to the fruits of their actions are pitiable.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नश्च सेनानीः सर्वसेनासु भारत। मतो मेऽतिरथो राजन् द्रोणशिष्यो महारथः॥
en: Dhrishtadyumna, the leader of all the (Pandava) armies, O Bharata, that great carwarrior, the pupil of Drona, is also an Atiratha, in my opinion, O king.

sa: यथा गोवृषभो वर्ष संधारयति खात् पतत्। भीमस्तथा द्रोणमुक्तं शरवर्षमदीधरत्॥
en: Just as a heifer bears the shower of rain falling from the skies, so did Bhima bear the arrowy downpour discharged by Drona, like one undaunted.

sa: ततः प्रववृते युद्धं व्यतिषक्तरथद्विपम्। पश्चिमां दिशमासाद्य स्थिते सवितरि प्रभो॥
en: Then, O lord, when the sun was on the western side of the meridian, there commenced a battle in which car-warriors and elephantriders encountered one another.

sa: सुंजयास्तु ततो दृष्ट्वा हृष्टं भीष्मं महारणे। सिंहनादांश्च विविधांश्चक्रुः शङ्खविमिश्रितान्॥
en: Thereupon the Srinjayas, beholding Bhishma in that battle, were filled with delight and they uttered numerous war-cries that became mingled with the blare of the conchs.

sa: परित्राणाय साधूनां विनाशाय त दुष्कृताम्। धर्मसंस्थापनार्थाय सम्भवामि युगे युगे॥
en: I take birth, age after age, for the protection of the good and the destruction of the wicked, and for the establishment of piety (true religion).

sa: तस्यैव मूर्धन्युशनाः काव्यो दैत्यैर्महीपते। इमानि तस्य रत्नानि तस्येमे रत्नपर्वताः॥
en: On the summit of that mountain, Ushanas, otherwise called the Poet, sports with the Dailyas. The jewels and gems and all precious stones belong to Meru.

sa: अर्जुनः केशवस्यात्माकृष्णोऽप्यात्मा किरीटिनः। अर्जुने विजयो नित्यं कृष्णे कीर्तिश्च शाश्वती॥
en: Arjuna is the soul of Keshava and Krishna is the soul of the diadem-decked (Arjuna). In Arjuna victory ever resides and eternal glory is in Krishna.

sa: ततः कृतास्त्रास्ते सर्वे परिवार्य वृकोदरम्। अभीताः समवर्तन्त शस्त्रवृष्ट्या परंतप॥
en: Thereafter they (the Kaurava combatants) exercised in all sorts of weapons surrounding, Vrikodara, began fearlessly to pour a shower of weapons on him from all sides.

sa: अन्योन्यं स्पर्धमानाच अन्योन्यस्य हिते रताः। दुर्योधनस्तु राजेन्द्र सैन्यमध्ये व्यवस्थितः॥
en: Striving to out view one another's and intent on one another's good. O foremost of kings, Duryodhana was stationed in the very centre of your troops.

sa: सिंहनादान् भृशं चक्रुः शङ्खान् दध्मुश्च हर्षिताः। भेरीश्च वादयामासुर्मृदङ्गांश्चानकैः सह॥
en: Transported with joy, they blew their conchs and gave forth roars resembling those of the lions and struck up their drums along with Mridangas and cymbals.

sa: यद्येवमहमज्ञास्यमशक्तान् रक्षणे मम। पुत्रस्य पाण्डुपञ्चालान् मया गुप्तो भवेत् ततः॥
en: Alas, if I had known that the Pandavas and the Panchalas would be incompetent to protect my son in battle, myself would then have protected him.

sa: रथशक्तीः समुत्क्षिप्य भूशं सिंहा इवानदन्। ता भुजाग्रैर्महावेगा निसृष्टा भुजगोपमाः॥
en: Then those mighty and blazing lances hurled with fury by the arms of those heroes, coursed swiftly towards Adhiratha's son, looking like so many (flying) snakes.

sa: अथवा बहुनैतेन किं ज्ञातेन तवार्जुन। विष्टभ्याहमिदं कृत्स्नमेकांशेन स्थितो जगत्।॥
en: O Arjuna, what have you to do, knowing all this at large? Know, I stand supporting this entire universe with only a portion of my Self.

sa: व्यपयातेषु वासाय सर्वेषु भरतर्षभ। हत्वा संशप्तकवातान् दिव्यैरस्त्रैः कपिध्वजः॥ प्रायात् स शिबिरं जिष्णु जैत्रमास्थाय तं रथम्। गच्छन्नेव च गोविन्दं साश्रुकण्ठोऽभ्यभाषत॥
en: Then, O foremost of the Bharatas, when the troops of both the hosts had retired to their respective quarters, the ape-bannered Jishnu having slain the Samshaptaka hosts with his celestial weapons, proceeded towards his pavilion mounted on that victorious chariot of his. As he went on, he asked Govinda, in a voice choked with tears.

sa: ततः सूतो मम सुहच्छरवर्षेण ताडितः। अपयातो रथोपस्थान्मनो मम विषादयन्॥
en: Then that well-wisher of mine, my charioteer, overpowered by that shower of arrows, fell down from his place in the car causing anxiety of my mind.

sa: तस्य द्रोणसुतश्चापं द्विधा चिच्छेद भारत। अथैनं छिन्नधन्वानं ताडयामास सायकैः॥
en: The son of Drona cut of the bow of Satyaki in twain. O Bharata; then he pierced him whose bow had been cut with numerous shafts.

sa: कर्णादवरजं बाणैर्जघान निशितैः शरैः। तत: शत्रुजयं हत्वा पार्थः षड्भिरजिह्मगैः॥
en: Thereafter Pritha's son having slain Satrunjaya also with six straight-going arrows, speedily deprived Vitapa of his head with lances, as the latter stood on his chariot.

sa: मङ्गा ब्राह्मणभूयिष्ठाः स्वकर्मनिरता नृप॥ मशकेषु तु राजन्या धार्मिकाः सर्वकामदाः।
en: The Mrigas are generally Brahmanas engaged in the duties of their own. Many virtuous Kshatriyas are among the Mashakas who grant every wish of the Brahmanas.

sa: यं प्रतिव्यूह्य तिष्ठन्ति पाण्डवास्तव वाहिनीम्। अजेयो मानुषे लोके पाण्डवैरभिरक्षितः॥
en: Thus placing their troops in this counterarray, the Pandavas waited for battle, Protected as it was by the Pandavas that Vyuha became impenetrable in the world.

sa: प्रमुखे सूतपुत्रस्य सोदर्या निहतास्त्रयः। ततो भीमः समुत्पत्य स्वरथाद् वैनतेयवत्॥
en: Then like second son of Vinata, Bhima jumping down from his chariot, slew with his sword of excellent make five and ten warriors of Karna's party.

sa: स तु विष्टभ्य गात्राणि दन्ताभ्यामवनिं ययौ। नदन्नार्तस्वनं प्राणनुत्ससर्ज महाद्विपः॥
en: With its limbs paralysed it fell down striking the earth with its tusks. Then that huge elephant gave up its breath uttering a yell of distress.

sa: अयुध्यमानाय ततः केशवाय नराधिप। क्षिप्ता श्रुतायुधेनाथ तस्मात् तमवधीदृ गदा॥
en: As Shrutayusha O ruler of men had hurled the mace at Krishna who was not engaged in the battle, it slew him who had hurled it.

sa: वार्ष्णेयस्तु ततो राजन् स्वां शक्तिं कनकप्रभाम्। वेगवद् गृह्य चिक्षेप पितामहरथं प्रति॥ वार्ष्णेयभुजवेगेन प्रणुन्ना सा महाहवे। अभिदुद्राव वेगेन कालरात्रिर्यथा नरम्॥
en: O king! Satyaki also picked up the Sakti having golden radiance and threw it with full might on the chariot of Bhishma. That Sakti so thrown with full might by Satyaki rushed rapidly towards Bhishma in that great war. It appeared as if the Kalaratri (the night of devastation) is forwarding to grip the man.

sa: अस्मानेवोपजीवंस्त्वमस्माकं विप्रिये रतः। न ह्ययं त्वां विजानामि मधुदिग्धमिव क्षुरं॥
en: Though you live upon our bread, yet you are instrumental in injuring us. I knew not before that, you are but a razor soaked in honey.

sa: दण्डो दमयतामस्मि नीतिरस्मि जिगीषताम्। मौनं चैवास्मि गुह्यानां ज्ञानं ज्ञानवतामहम्॥
en: I am the rod of the chastisers, and the policy of those that seek victory. I am silence in secrets, and the knowledge of the learned.

sa: वृद्धैर्द्विजातिभिर्गुप्ता धात्र्या चानुगता तदा। अतीत्य च तमध्वानमासाद्य नृपति तथा॥
en: She was escorted by old twice born men and followed by maid servants; and after traveling the whole distance she reached the presence of that king.

sa: तत्राद्भुतमपश्याम तयो?रं पराक्रमम्। अयुध्येतां स्थिरौ भूत्वा महत्या सेनया सह॥
en: We saw wonderful prowess in those two princes for they fought with great coolness, though they had to fight with a very large number of troops.

sa: विराटदुपदौ वृद्धौ कुन्तिभोजश्च दंशितः। अभ्यद्रवन्त गाङ्गेयं पुत्रस्य तव पश्यतः॥
en: Also the two aged warriors Virata and Drupada, and Kuntibhoja each protected with an armour, rushed against Ganga's son before the very eyes of your son.

sa: स्मासाद्य तु तं शैलं शैलाग्रे समवस्थितम्। तपोनित्यं महात्मानमपश्यद् वृषभध्वजम्॥
en: Having reached that hill he beheld that high-souled Divinity having the bull for his emblem on the banner, seated on its peak and lost in contemplation.

sa: दिवस्पृङ् नरवीराणां निघ्नतामितरेतरम्। सम्प्रहारे सुतुमुले तव तेषां च भारत॥
