en: O descendant of Bharata, the shouts of the heroic combatants of your army and those of your enemies when killing one another, reached the very heavens.

sa: जघान चन्द्रवर्माणं बृहत्क्षत्रं च नैषधम्। ततः स्वरथमास्थाय पाञ्चाल्योऽनयच्च कार्मुकम्॥
en: Thereafter mounting on his chariot and taking up a bow, the prince of the Panchalas pierced Karna with seventy-three shafts uttering loud shouts all the while.

sa: परिष्वज्य सुतं चापि आत्मनः सदृशं गुणैः। प्रीतिमाननयत् पार्थो देवराजनिवेशन॥
en: Then in the mansion of the chief of the celestial, the son of Pritha embracing his son equal to him in his acquirements, was highly delighted.

sa: तं प्रत्यविध्यद् दशभिर्भीमसेनः शिलीमुखैः। त्वरमाणो महेष्वासः सव्ये पार्श्वे महाबलः॥
en: But the highly puissant Bhimasena, that fierce bow-man, without the least delay, pierced Drona in return in his left side with ten shafts of great sharpness.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा महाबाहुर्दशाहानि महायशाः। नायुध्यत ततः कर्णः पुत्रस्य तव सम्मते॥
en: Having thus spoken, the mighty-armed Karna of illustrious renown, refrained, with the perinission of your son, from taking part in the battle for these ten days.

sa: प्रीतस्तेऽभिगमेनाहं जयं तव नराधिप। आशासिष्ये सदोत्थाय सत्यमेतद् ब्रवीमि ते॥
en: I am pleased by your coming. O king, rising every day (from my bed), I shall pray for your victory. I truly speak this to you.

sa: एतमर्थं च विज्ञाय श्रुत्वा च प्रभुमव्ययम्। वासुदेवं महात्मानं लोकानामीश्वरेश्वरम्॥
en: Having heard the truth about the subject, and having heard of Vasudeva the undeteriorating Lord of illustrious soul, the supreme Master of the Lords of people.

sa: संकुद्धान् पाण्डवानेको एद् दधारास्त्रतेजसा। तत् तस्य कर्म भूतानि सर्वाण्येवाश्यपूजयन्॥
en: Then all creatures praised that fcat of his which was nothing less than checking the enraged Pandava hosts by means of the force of his weapons.

sa: सुदक्षिणस्तु समरे साहदेविं महारथम्। विद्ध्वा नाकम्पयत वै मैनाकमिव पर्वतम्॥
en: O king of kings, Sudakshina wounded that great car-warrior the son of Sahadeva, but he could not make him waver; he stood as the Mainaka mountain.

sa: ते वध्यमाना भीमेन मातङ्गा गिरिसंनिभाः। निपेतुरुवा॒ सहिता नादयन्तो वसुन्धराम्॥
en: Those elephants, huge bodied like the hills, being thus slaughtered in battle fell down on the earth in large numbers, filling the earth with their roars.

sa: संकुद्धान् पाण्डवानेको एद् दधारास्त्रतेजसा। तत् तस्य कर्म भूतानि सर्वाण्येवाश्यपूजयन्॥
en: Then all creatures praised that fcat of his which was nothing less than checking the enraged Pandava hosts by means of the force of his weapons.

sa: अवहारं ततः कृत्वा भारद्वाजस्य सम्मते। लब्धलक्षैः शरैर्भिन्ना भृशावहसिता रणे॥
en: Withdrawing from the field with the consent of Bharadvaja's son, after being vanquished by their adversaries of unerring aim and humiliated by them in the conflict.

sa: ततः सैन्धवमालोक्य कार्ष्णिरुत्सृज्य पौरवम्। उत्पपात रथात् तूर्णे श्येनवनिपपात च॥
en: Thereupon the nephew of of Krishna beholding the prince of the Sindhus, left Paurava alone and like a hawk suddenly jumped down from the latter's car.

sa: तमा निवशं प्राप्तं कृष्यमाणमनाथवत्। पौरवं पातितं दृष्ट्वा नामृष्यत जयद्रथः।६२॥
en: Then beholding Paurava at the mercy of the son of Arjuna and dragged like one helpless and fallen on the ground, Jayadratha did not tolerate it.

sa: तेषामापततां श्रुत्वा शब्दं त तावकं बलम्। भीमसेनभयोद्विग्नं विवर्णवदनं तथा॥
en: Hearing that noise of the assaulting army, the warriors of the army of your sons, wore a pallid countenance being agitated with the fear of Bhimasena;

sa: तस्य शब्देन वित्रस्तास्तावका भरतर्षभ। सिंहस्येव मृगा राजन् व्यद्रवन्त महाभयात्॥
en: Terrified at his roars, your warriors, O foremost of the Bharatas, fied, O king, out of panic, like deer flying at the sight of a lion.

sa: प्रायात् पुनर्महाबाहुराचार्यस्य रथं प्रति। पश्यतां सर्वसैन्यानां मध्येन भ्रातृभिः सह॥
en: That mighty-armed hero surrounded by his brother then went towards the chariot of the preceptor (Drona) through the fines of soldiers who all looked at him.

sa: तस्मिंस्तथा वर्तमाने संग्रामे लोमहर्षणे। धार्तराष्ट्रं महत् सैन्यं प्रायशो विमुखीकृतम्॥
en: When that hair-string comb was thus raging, the troops belonging to Dhritarashtra's army were generally made to turn back their faces from the field of battle.

sa: अप्रकाशोऽप्रवृत्तिश्च प्रमादो मोह एव च। तमस्येतानि जायन्ते विवृद्धे कुरुनन्दन॥
en: When, O son of the Kuru race gloom, inactivity, error, and delusion, are born in this body, then should one know that Tama has been developed.

sa: तामापतन्ती समरे शरवृष्टिं सुदारुणाम्। असिना तीक्ष्णधारेण चिच्छेद बलिनां वरः॥
en: Then that foremost of those possessed of prowess (Shikhandin) cut off with his sharpedged sword the dreadful shower of arrows that was falling fast upon him.

sa: विराटश्च ततः पश्चाद् राजाऽथाक्षौहिणीवृतः। भ्रातृभिः सह पुत्रैश्च सोऽभ्यरक्षत पृष्ठतः॥
en: The king Virata, accompanied by his brothers and sons, and surrounded by one Akshauhini of soldiers, marched in the rear and protected the army from behind.

sa: राक्षसेन्द्रस्ततस्तस्य धनुश्चिच्छेद भारत। अर्धचन्द्रेण समरे तं च विव्याध सायकैः॥
en: Thereat, O Bharata, that foremost of the Rakshasas cut off Satyaki's bow with a crescent-shaped arrow in that combat, and pierced the latter with numerous arrows.

sa: अपेतकर्णाः पुत्रास्ते राजानश्चैव तावकाः। निर्ययुः सिंहनादेन नादयन्तो दिशो दश॥
en: Then your sons and all the kings that were on his side without Karna marched making the ten points of horizon resound with their war cries.

sa: नरो बाणविनिर्भिन्नो रथादन्यश्च मारिष। तत्रान्यस्य च सम्म पतितस्य विवर्मणः॥
en: Others fell down, O sire, from their chariots, with hearts torn open with arrows. In that terrible crush as men fell down deprived of their armours.

sa: ततो दुर्मर्पणो भीममभ्यगच्छत् सुतस्तव। आराद् दृष्ट्वा किरन् बाणैर्जिघृक्षुस्तस्य जीवितम्॥
en: Thereafter your son Durmarsana beholding Bhima near him, fell upon him; and desirous of saving Drona's life, he covered the latter with a downpour of arrows.

sa: इरावानपि संक्रुद्धो मायां स्रष्टुं प्रचक्रमे। तस्य क्रोधाभिभूतस्य समरेष्वनिवर्तिनः॥
en: Iravat, highly excited with rage, himself began to create great illusions. Then when that unreceding hero was over-whelmed with rage in that battle,

sa: ध्वजं तु भीमसेनस्य वेदूर्यमणिलोचनम्। भ्राजमानं महासिंहं राजन्तं दृष्टवानहम्॥
en: The standard of Bhimasena bearing the device of a mighty lion in silver, with two eyes of the lapis lazuli, appeared highly resplendent.

sa: सैन्धवश्च कलिङ्गश्च विकर्णश्च तवात्मजः। दक्षिणं पार्श्वमास्थाय समतिष्ठन्त दंशिताः॥
en: Donning their armours, the king of the Sindhus and the Kalingas and Vikarna, your son, stationed themselves in the right wing of Drona.

sa: ततोऽर्जुनो जातमन्युष्र्णेयं वीक्ष्य पीडितम्॥ दुःशासनं शतेनाजौ नाराचानां समार्पयत्।
en: Thereat Arjuna waxing wroth upon beholding him of the Vrishni race afflicted with arrows, sped hundred long shafts at Dushasana in that encounter.

sa: द्रौपदीहरणे राजन् परिक्लिष्टश्च पाण्डवैः। संस्मरंस्तं परिक्लेशं योत्स्यते परवीरहा।॥
en: Persecuted by the Pandavas, O king, in his attempt to carry away Draupadi, that slayer of hostile heroes will fight remembering that trouble.

sa: पुत्रस्तु तव दुर्धर्षो नकुलस्य महाहवे। तुरङ्गांश्चिच्छिदे बाणैर्ध्वजं चैवाभ्यपातयत्॥
en: Your son who is ever difficult to be vanquished then killed in that fearful battle Nakula's horses and then cut down his standard.

sa: स नागप्रवरेणाजौ बलिना शीघ्रगामिना। यतो दुर्योधनरथस्तं मार्ग प्रत्यवर्तत॥
en: This king, in that battle, riding on his excellent elephant ofs, great strength and fleetness, reached the spot where Duryodhana's car was stationed;

sa: ग्रहनक्षत्रशबला द्यौरिवासीद् वसुन्धरा। एवमेते महासेने मृदृिते तत्र भारत॥
en: The earth looked like the sky be-spangled with the stars and the planets. Thus, O Bharata, the two mighty armies crushed one another,

sa: गजस्कन्धगतानां च पुरुषाणां किरीटिना। छिद्यन्ते चोत्तमाङ्गानि भल्लैः संनतपर्वभिः॥
en: The diadem-decked Arjuna then cut-off with bhallas of close knots, the heads of hostile warriors that rode on the neck of these elephants.

sa: यस्तमोऽर्क इवापोहन् परसैन्यममित्रहा। सहस्ररश्मिप्रतिमः परेषां भयमादधत्॥ अकरोद् दुष्करं कर्म रणे पाण्डुसुतेषु यः। ग्रसमानमनीकानि य एनं पर्यवारयन्॥
en: When he attacked the enemy's rank who were the warriors that opposed the chastiser of foes who resembled the and who, spreading terror among the foes destroyed their ranks as the sun destroys darkness, and who achieved exceedingly difficult feats amongst the ranks of the Pandavas?

sa: अथकर्णस्य सचिवान् षट् शूरूंचित्रयोधिनः। साश्वसूतध्वजरथान् सौभद्रो निजघान ह॥
en: Then Subhadra's son slew six of Karna's ministers all versed in various modes of warfare, together with their horses, charioteer, car and standards.

sa: कारणद्वयमास्थाय नाहं योत्स्यामि पाण्डवान्॥ अवध्यत्वाच्च पाण्डूनां स्त्रीभावाच्च शिखण्डिनः।
en: I shall not fight with the Pandavas for two reasons, viz., for the unslayableness of the Pandavas and for the femininity of Shikhandin.

sa: क्षरन्निव महामेघो वारिधाराः सहस्रशः। द्रोणमेघः पार्थशैलं ववर्ष शरवृष्टिभिः॥
en: Then like a mighty mass of clouds pouring down incessant showers of rain, the Dronacloud covered the Arjuna-mountain with his shower of arrows.

sa: तामापतन्ती सम्प्रेक्ष्य ज्वलन्तीमशनीमिव॥ समादत्त शितान् भल्लान् पञ्च पाण्डवनन्दनः।
en: Beholding that lance course towards himself like the blazing bolt of Heaven, the son of Pandu took up five sharp broad headed arrows,

sa: विव्यधुः कर्णमासाद्य त्रिभिस्त्रिभिरजिह्मगैः। अर्जुनास्त्रं तु राधेयः संवार्य शरवृष्टिभिः॥
en: Thereupon Radha's son, having at first resisted Arjuna's weapons by his arrowy showers, cut-off the bow of those three warriors with three darts.

sa: ततः काम्बोजराजस्य पुत्रः शूरः सुदक्षिणः। अभ्ययाज्जवनैरश्वैः फाल्गुनं शत्रुसूदनम्॥
en: Thereafter the heroic Sudakshina the son of the Kamboja king rushed against that slayer of foes viz., Phalguna, being borne by fleet steeds.

sa: न ममैतद् द्विषत्सैन्यं कलामर्हति षोडशीम्। अपि विश्वजितं विष्णुं मातुलं प्राप्य सूतज॥ पितरं चार्जुनं युद्धे न भीर्मामुपयास्यति।
en: This host of the enemy is not competent to fight even with the sixteenth part of myself. Getting, O son of a driver, my uncle (maternal), the world-conquering Vishnu or my father, for my antagonist in battle, I will not this day be overcome with terror."

sa: वृषभस्तु महाराज बहुधा विपरिक्षतः। अमुच्यत महारौद्रात् तस्माद् वीरावकर्तनात्॥
en: Only Vrishabha, O mighty monarch, with his body mangled with wounds, escaped, with difficulty, alive from that most terrible combat destructive of heroes.

sa: सांकृते रन्तिदेवस्य यां रात्रिमतिथिर्वसेत्॥ आलभ्यन्त तदा गावः सहस्राण्येकविंशतिः।
en: On such nights when guests used to assemble in the mansion of Ratindeva, twentyone thousand cows used to be sacrificed (for feeding them).

sa: तेष्वनीकेषु यत्तेषु व्यूढेषु च विधानतः। दुर्योधनो महाराज दुःशासनमथाब्रवीत्॥
en: When the troops were arrayed according to the rule, when they were all ready for battle. O king, Duryodhana thus spoke to Dushasana.

sa: सात्यकोऽपि ततस्तूर्णं भीमस्य प्रियकाम्यया। गाङ्गेयसारथिं तूर्णं पातयामास सायकैः॥
en: Satyaki however, in order to do what is agreeable to Bhima, cut down with his arrows the charioteer of the revered Kuru grandfather.

sa: भीष्मस्तु वेदनां धैर्यानिगृह्य भरतर्षभ। अभितप्तः शरैश्चैव निःश्वसन्नुरगो यथा।॥
en: Then, O foremost of the Bharatas, Bhishma, having overcome his pain by his patience, and afflicted with many dares, breathed like a snake.

sa: अग्रतः सर्वसैन्यानां भीष्मः शान्तनवो ययौ। मालवैर्दाक्षिणात्यैश्च आवन्त्यैश्च समन्वितः॥
en: Then Bhishma the son of Shantanu marched out in the van of all the troops, supported by the Malavas, the Southerners and Avantyas.

sa: रजोमेघास्तु संजजुः शस्त्रविद्युद्भिरावृताः। धनुषां चापि निर्घोषो दारुणः समपद्यत॥
en: Clouds of dust were raised in which played the lighting consisting of the flashes of weapons. The twang of bows also became tremendous.

sa: सुदक्षिणश्च निहतः स च राजा श्रुतायुधः। श्रुतायुश्चाच्युतायुश्चम्लेच्छाश्चायुतशो हताः॥
en: as He by whom Sudakshina and king Shrutayusha have been slain, also Shrutayusha and Achytayusha and myriads of Mlechchas also have been slain.

sa: घटोत्कचोऽथ संक्रुद्धो भगदत्तमुपाद्रवत्। विकटः परुषो राजन् दीप्तास्यो दीप्तलोचनः॥
en: Ghatotkacha excited to the highest pitch of fury, rushed against the former. That being of fierce aspect, with countenance and eyes flashing fire,

sa: तथा तमात्मजं युद्धे विक्रमन्तमरिंदमम्। दृष्ट्वा पार्थः सुसंयत्तं सिंहनादमथानदत्॥
en: When Partha saw that chastiser of foes, his son thus fighting and displaying his prowess in battle, he sent up a lion-like shout.

sa: एषामन्तरविष्कम्भो योजनानि सहस्रशः। तत्र पुण्या जनपदास्तानि वर्षाणि भारत॥
en: The space between them extends cne thousand Yojanas. There are many delightful kingdoms thereon. O descendant of Bharata, these divisions are called Varshas.

sa: स तथा पीड्यमानस्तु राधेयेनास्त्रवृष्टिभिः॥ समरेऽमरसंकाशः सौभद्रो न व्यशीर्यत।
en: Though thus afflicted with showers of weapons hurled by Radha's son, yet the son of Subhadra equal to an immortal, did not flinch.

sa: ब्रुवाणं तु तथा पार्थं सर्वसैन्यानि भारत। अपूजयंस्तदा वाग्भिरनुकूलाभिराहवे॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, when Partha (Arjuna) was thus speaking, all the troops worshipped him on the field of battle with congratulatory words.

sa: अर्जुनप्रमुखाः पार्थाः पुरस्कृत्य शिखण्डिनम्। भीष्मं युद्धेऽभ्यवर्तन्त किरन्तो विविधाञ्छरान्॥
en: The son of Pritha headed by Arjuna, placing Shikhandin in front of them, advanced towards Bhishma in battle, shooting arrows of various descriptions.

sa: पौत्रं तव च दुर्धर्षे लक्ष्मणं प्रियदर्शनम्। पितुः समीपे तिष्ठन्तं शूरमुद्यतकार्मुकम्॥ अत्यन्तसुखसंवृद्धं धनेश्वरसुतोपमम्। आससाद रणे कार्ष्णिमत्तो मत्तमिव द्विपम्॥
en: Then like one infuriate elephant meeting another in the same state, Krishna's nephew encountered your grandson Lakshmana, invincible, of great personal beauty, standing near his father with his bow ready for use, endued with heroism, brought up in all luxury and resembling the son of the God or wealth.

sa: धनंजय कथं शक्यमस्माभिर्यो माहवे। धार्तराष्टैर्महाबाहो येषां योद्धा पितामहः॥
en: "O mighty armed hero, O Dhananjaya, how shall be able to fight with the Dhritarashtra's son's army when the grandfather himself commands it.

sa: ततस्ताशरजालेन संनिवार्य महारथान्। पार्थः समन्तात् समरे प्रेषयमास मृत्यवे॥
en: Then checking those mighty car-warriors with the net-work of arrows woven by himself, Partha began to dispatch them to the regions of Death.

sa: ततः प्रववृते युद्धं व्यतिपक्तरथद्विपम्॥ तावकानां परेषां च निजतामितरेतरम्।
en: Then commenced the battle between your troops and the foes; all struck at one another; elephants and cars mixed up in one confusion.

sa: तं चोपहारं सुकृतं नैशं नैत्यकमात्मना। ददर्श त्र्यम्बकाभ्याशे वासुदेवनिवेदितम्॥
en: He then beheld by the side of the three-eyed god, the offerings he used to make, every night, to the son of Vasudeva.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा महाबाहुर्महद् विस्फार्ये कार्मुकम्। भारद्वाजस्ततो भीमं षड्विंशत्या समार्पयत्॥
en: The mighty-armed son of Bharadvaja also, having spoken the above words, stretched his mighty bow and afflicted Bhima with twenty ! six shafts.

sa: तमादित्योऽनुपर्येति सततं ज्योतिषां वरः। चन्द्रमाश्च सनक्षत्रो वायुश्चैव प्रदक्षिणः॥
en: That foremost of luminaries, the sun, always goes round the Meru, so does the moon with his attendant constellations so does also Vayu.

sa: समुद्यतेषु चास्त्रेषु समप्राप्ते च युधिष्ठिरे। अकुर्वन्नार्यकर्माणि भैरवे सत्यभीतवत्॥
en: During that fierce encounter, they dauntlessly followed their commander, achieving numerous feats of valour, with weapons upraised and with Yudhishthira within accessible distance.

sa: महता रथवंशेन पार्थस्यावारयन् दिशः। तथैव भगदत्तश्च श्रुतायुश्च महाबलः॥
en: These warriors, along with a mighty division of cars, surrounded Pritha's son on all directions. Also Bhagadatta and Shrutayusha, endued with great strength,

sa: अश्वत्थामा ततः क्रुद्धो निमेषार्धाच्छिखण्डिनः। ध्वजं सूतमथो राजंस्तुरगानायुधानि च॥ शरैर्बहुभिराच्छिद्य पातयामास संयुगे। स हताश्वादवप्लुत्य रथाद् वै रथिनां वरः॥
en: Thereupon waxing worth, within half the lime taken up by the wink, Ashvathama cut off in that combat Shikhandin's Shikhandin's charioteer, standard, horses and weapons covering them, O king, with innumerable arrows, then that foremost of car-warriors jumped down from the car of which, the steeds had been slain.

sa: विभित्सता रथानीकं सौभद्रेणामितौजसा। विक्रीडितं यथा संख्ये तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय॥
en: Tell me, O Sanjaya, how in battle did the dauntless son of Subhadra, endued with immeasurable might sport, having penetrated into our car-division.

sa: शरवर्षं ततस्तत् तु संनिवार्य महायशाः। मध्ये चिच्छेद कार्मुकम्॥
en: Then that great car-warrior, Drona, baffling that shower of arrows, cut off the bow of the son of Drupada at a favourable opportunity.

sa: भग्नाक्षोपस्करान् कांश्चिद् भग्नचक्रांश्च भारत। अपश्याम महाराज शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: We beheld, O monarch, chariots by hundreds and thousands then, some with their Akihas shattered and bottoms broken, some with their wheels broken.

sa: जाम्भूनदविचित्रेण कर्णिकारेण केतुना। अभ्यवर्तत भीष्म च तांश्चैव रथसत्तमान्॥
en: And adorned with a standard decked with pure gold and resembling a Karnikara tree, he attacked Bhishma and those five foremost of car-warriors.

sa: अभिज्ञानानि सर्वेषां संज्ञाश्चाभरणानि च। योजयामास कौरव्यो युद्धकाल उपस्थिते॥
en: That Kuru prince also fixed names and emblems for all of them, so that they might be recognised at the time of battle.

sa: ततः क्राथः शरव्रातैरार्जुनिं समवाकिरत्। अथेतरे संनिवृत्ताः पुनर्दोणमुखा रथाः॥
en: Thereafter Kratha covered Arjuna's son with showers of arrows; meanwhile many other car-warriors headed by Drona, turning back to the field of battle,

sa: तु वासवमिवायान्तं भूरिवर्षं शरौघिणम्। महेष्वासा नरव्याघ्रा नोग्रं केचिदवारयन्॥
en: None could then resist that fierce bowmen, that excellent of all male beings, as he advanced, like Indra, pouring incessantly showers of arrows.

sa: निष्पेतुर्विमलाः शक्त्यस्तैलधौताः सुतेजनाः। अम्बुदेभ्यो यथा राजन् भ्राजमानाः शतह्रदाः॥
en: Resplendent dares cleansed with oil and shot with great force, began to fall, O king, like flashing forks of lightening from the clouds.

sa: ततोभीष्मश्च राजा च कौसल्यश्च बृहद्बलः। समवर्तन्त संक्रुद्धा भीमसेनधनंजयौ॥
en: Thereupon Bhishma, king Duryodhana himself, the ruler of the Kosalas and Brihadbala, all excited with rage assailed in a body Bhimasena and Dhananjaya.

sa: ततस्तालध्वजः शूरः पाण्डवानां वरूथिनीम्। छादया समरे शरैः संनतपर्वभिः॥
en: Then that hero, owning the standard bearing the device of the palmyra tree, covered the Pandava host in that battle with straightknotted shafts.

sa: तं याम सर्वे महता बलेन मा वो रिपुः प्रार्थयतामनीकम्। श्रुत्वा तु वाक्यं तममृष्यमाणा ज्येष्ठाज्ञया नोदिता धार्तराष्ट्राः॥
en: We shall proceed against him in close array in order to slay him, even before he, our enemy, challenges us to fight.” Hearing these words, the sons of Dhritarashtra, urged on by the command of their elder brother and unable to put up with the foe,

sa: सरो हंसा इवापेतुर्भ्रान्तो द्रोणरथं प्रति। गृह्णीताद्रवतान्योन्यं विभीता विनिकृन्तत॥
en: Then near the chariot of the invincible Drona, loud cries of “Seize," "Do not fly," "Be not afraid” “Cut to pieces" were heard.

sa: ततो वादित्रनिर्घोषैर्माङ्गल्यैश्च स्तवैः शुभैः। प्रायान्तमर्जुनं वीरं मागधाश्चैव तुष्टुवुः॥
en: The minstrels and musicians then greeted the heroic Arjuna as he proceeded, with the sounds of musical instruments and eulogies, auspicious and well-worded.

sa: तमन्वगात् सत्यधृतिः सौचित्तियुद्धदुर्मदः। श्रेणिमान् वसुदानश्च पुत्रः काश्यस्य चाभिभूः॥
en: Him followed Satyadhriti and Sauchitti ever invincible in battle, and Shrenimat and Vasudhara and the puissant son of the king of the Kashis,

sa: ककुदं सर्वयोधानां धाम सर्वधनुष्मताम्। शरतल्पगतः सोऽद्य शेते कुरुपितामहः॥
en: The foremost of all warriors, that prowess personified of all bow-men, that grandfather of the Kurus, today lies on the bed of arrows.

sa: तमन्वयात् सत्यधृतिः सौचित्तियुद्धदुर्मदः। श्रेणिमान् वसुदानश्च पुत्रः काश्यस्य चाभिभूः॥
en: Satyadhriti and Sauchithi both irrepressible in battle followed him, as also Shrenimat, Vasudana and Vibhu the son of the ruler of Kasis. or

sa: विशोकस्तमुवाचेदं धृष्टद्युम्नं कृताञ्जलिः। संस्थाप्य मामिह बली पाण्डवेयः पराक्रमी॥
en: Thereupon, folding his palm, Vishoka thus replied to Dhrishtadyumna saving: Leaving me here, the mighty son of Pandu (Bhima), possessed of great strength.

sa: सहयज्ञाः प्रजाः सृष्ट्वा पुरोवाच प्रजापतिः। अनेन प्रसविष्यध्वमेष वोऽस्त्विष्टकामधुक्॥
en: In olden times, Creator, having created men with Sacrifice, said; “Multiply by this. May it be the giver of all that you desire.

sa: समुद्रमिव धर्मान्ते विशन् घोरो महानिलः। व्याक्षोभयदनीकानि पाण्डवानां द्विजोत्तमः॥
en: Then that foremost of regenerate heroes, namely Drona, agitated the Pandava hosts like a raging tempest of the summer, agitating the mighty main.

sa: प्राक्रोशन् प्राद्रवंश्चान्ये जग्मुर्मोहः तथापरे॥ क्षत्रं चान्येऽभ्यनिन्दन्त भीष्मं चान्येऽभ्यपूजयन्।
en: Some wept aloud, some ran wildly, some were overwhelmed with swoon; some then censured the life of a Kshatriya and some worshipped Bhishma.

sa: सहस्रं मुसलेनाहन् सहस्रमसिनाऽवधीत्। उद्बन्धनात् सहस्रं च सहस्रमुदके धृतम्॥
en: He slew a thousand Kshatriyas with his bludgeon, a thousand with his sword and a thousand of the Kshatriyas also by hanging them.

sa: ततस्तेषां शरीरैश्च शरीरावयवैश्च सः। तस्तार क्षिति क्षिप्रं कुशैर्वेदिमिवाध्वरे॥
en: Then with their bodies and their severed parts, Abhimanyu covered the earth like a priest covering the alter with Kusha-grass during a sacrifice.

sa: तथैव सबलाश्चेमे राजानो राजसत्तम॥ त्वत्प्रसादं प्रतीक्षन्ते त्वद्भक्ताश्च विशाम्पते।
en: O best of kings, O monarch, all these kings with their troops are all in your favour. They are all devoted to you.

sa: विषक्तैः स शरैश्चापि तपनीयपरिच्छदैः। आHशृङ्गिर्बभौ राजन् दीप्तशृङ्ग इवाचलः॥
en: Struck with those arrows furnished with golden wings, the Rishyashringa, O king appeared beautiful like an immovable hill with its crest on fire.

sa: अश्रद्दधानाः पुरुषा धर्मस्यास्य परंतप। अप्राप्य मां निवर्तन्ते मृत्युसंसारवर्त्मनि॥
en: Those men, O terror of foes, who have no faith in this sacred doctrine, return to this mortal world without attaining to Me.

sa: स विधातं पृषत्कानामङ्कुशेन समाहरन्॥ गजेन पाण्डुपञ्चालान् व्यधमत् पर्वतेश्वरः।
en: Baffling those myriad shafts with his iron hook, the Mountain-king, (Bhagadatta) agitated with his elephant the host of the Pandavas and the Panchalas.

sa: अदृश्यत महारौद्रा गदा नागाश्वपातनी। तत्र तत्र हतैश्चापि मनुष्यगजवाजिभिः॥
en: His mace, that dealt death to steeds and elephants, appeared exceedingly terrible. With corpses and carcasses of steeds, men and elephants and horse-soldiers.

sa: इत्यवोचमहं तांश्च क्षत्रधर्मव्यपेक्षया। मम व्रतमिदं लोके नाहं युद्धात् कदाचन॥ विमुखो विनिवर्तेयं पृष्ठतोऽभ्याहतः शरैः। नाहं लोभान्न कार्पण्यान्न भयानार्थकारणात्॥
en: “No” I said to them “according to the duty of a Kshatriya, this is my vow, that never from battle, I will turn back or suffer my back to be wondered by arrows. Not from covering any objects of desire, nor from fear, nor for the sake of wealth,

sa: यज्ञशिष्टामृतभुजो यान्ति ब्रह्म सनातनम्। नायं लोकोऽस्त्ययज्ञस्य कुतोऽन्यः कुरुसत्तम॥
en: O best of Kurus, this world is not for those who do not perform any Sacrifice, what to speak of the future world.

sa: लक्ष्मणेन तु संगम्य सौभद्रः परवीरहा। शरैः सुनिशितैस्तीक्ष्णैर्बाह्वोरुरसि चार्पितः॥
en: Encountering Lakshmana, that slayer of hostile heroes, that son of Subhadra, was pierced on the breast and the arms with exceedingly sharp shafts.

sa: तस्मिन्नयुतशो राजन् भूयशश्च परतपः। भीष्मं शान्तनवो योधाञ्जघान परमास्त्रवित्॥
en: Then Bhishma, the son of Shantanu, that hero conversant with excellent weapons, slew, O afflicter of foes, many warriors by millions and thousands.

sa: ग्रहनक्षत्रसोमानां सूर्याग्न्योश्च समत्विषम्। अपश्यत तदा पार्थो ज्वलन्तमिव पर्वतम्॥
en: Partha then beheld a mountain blazing as if with the effulgence of the planets, the stars, the moon, the sun and the fire.

sa: यदि नाहं परित्याज्यो युवाभ्यामिह संयुगे। विक्रमेणानुरूपेण युध्येतां पुरुषर्षभौ॥
en: O foremost of men, if I do not deserve to be abandoned by you two, then fight at the utmost of your power".

sa: पूर्णायतविसृष्टेन पीतेन निशितेन च। निर्बिभेद महाराज राजपुत्रं बृहद्बलम्॥
en: Then, O mighty monarch, he pierced prince Brihadbala with another sharp and welltempered arrow, shot from his bow drawn to its fullest stretch.

sa: आश्रमं पुण्यशीलानां तापसानां महात्मनाम्। ततस्तामवसद् रात्रिं तापसैः परिवारिता॥
en: To a hermitage of a great souled anchorite of virtuous ways of life and she stayed there for the night surrounded by anchorites.

sa: दशैते तावका योधा भीमसेनमयोधयन्॥ महत्या सेनया युक्ता नानादेशसमुत्थया।
en: These ten warriors of your army engaged with Bhimasena in battle, supported by a large division consisting of troops recruited from various countries,

sa: तदस्त्रमस्त्रेण विदार्यमाणं खस्थाः सुरा ददृशुःपार्थिवाश्च। भीष्मस्तु राजन् समरे महात्मा धनुश्च चित्रं ध्वजमेव चापि॥ छित्त्वाऽनदत् पाण्डुसुतस्य वीरो युधिष्ठिरस्याजमीढस्य राज्ञः। ततः समुत्सृज्य धनुः सबाण युधिष्ठिरं वीक्ष्य भयाभिभूतम्॥
en: The celestial in the heavens and the rulers of the earth, all beheld that weapon (fiery darc of Shalya) baffled by Shikhandin's (Varuna) arrow. In that battle, O king, the high-souled and heroic Bhishma also uttered his war-cry having cut off the bow and wonderfully variegated standard of the royal son of Pandu viz., Yudhishthira of the Ajamida race. Thereupon seeing Yudhishthira overwhelmed with fear, leaving aside his bow and his arrows,

sa: युगाधु छिन्नमादाय प्रदुद्राव तथा हयः। सासिहुर्निपतितः शिरश्छिन्नं सकुण्डलम्॥
en: Dragging halves of broken yokes, horses began to ran away. Arms with swords in their grasps fell, as also heads graced with ear-rings.

sa: द्रोणस्तु समरे क्रुद्धः पुत्रस्य प्रियकृत् तव। व्यधमत् सर्वपञ्चालास्तूलराशिमिवानलः॥
en: Drona also, that well-wisher of your son, excited with wrath began to consume all the Panchalas like fire consuming a heap of cotton.

sa: तस्य चिन्तयतो दुःखमनिशं पार्थिवस्य तत्। आजगाम विशुद्धात्मा पुनर्गावल्गणिस्तदा॥
en: When that foremost of the Kurus had been thus brooding over his grief, there came again to him the pure-souled son of Gavalgani.

sa: स्वयमेवात्मनाऽऽत्मानं वेत्थं त्वं पुरुषोत्तम। भूतभावन भूतेष देवदेव जगत्पते॥
en: O best of beings, creator of all things, God of gods, Lord of the universe, you only know yourself by your great Self.

sa: काम्बोजराजो बलवांस्ततः पश्चात् सुदक्षिणः। मागधच जयत्सेनः सौबलश्च बृहद्बलः॥
en: After them came the powerful Sudakshina, the king of the Kambojas, Jayatsena of the Magadha kingdom, and the son of Subala, and Brihadbala.

sa: धनंजयरथं शीघ्रं शरवर्षैरवाकिरत्। क्षणेन स रथस्तस्य सहयः सहसारथिः॥
en: And then quickly covered the car of Dhananjaya with a shower of arrows. Within a moment Arjuna's car with the steeds and charioteer,

sa: तमतिक्रुद्ध मायान्तं तव पुत्रमरिंदमः। अभिमन्युः शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः षड्विंशत्या समार्पयत्॥
en: Then, O subduer of your foes, beholding your wrathful son advance furiously towards himself, Abhimanyu wounded him, with twenty-six arrows of exceeding sharpness.

sa: कामवर्णजवैरश्चैर्बहुभिः संवृतो नृप। ते हयाः काञ्चनापीडा नानावर्णा मनोजवाः॥
en: 0 king, surrounded by parti-coloured horses, countless in number. Those horses caparisoned with trappings of gold and of diverse hues and great fleetness,

sa: ववर्ष तत्र पर्जन्यो मांसशोणितवृष्टिमान्। दिक्षु सर्वाणि सैन्यानि तदद्भुतमिवाभवत्॥
en: A black clouds of flesh and blood showered a down pour over that vast assemblage of troops. Every thing appeared to be wonderful.

sa: तथा भीष्मकृपद्रोणशल्यदुर्योधनादिभि। तवापि च वभौ सेना ग्रहैद्यौरिव संवृता॥
en: So also, your troops, O king, with Bhishma, Drona, Kripa, Shalya, Duryodhana and others, appeared beautiful like the firmament covered with the planets.

sa: ततः क्षणेन क्षितिपं क्षतजप्रतिमेक्षणः। क्षयं निनीषुर्निशितैर्भीमो विव्याध पत्रिभिः॥
en: Thereat, with blood-red eyes, Bhima within a while, desirous of dragging the king to destruction, began to pierce the latter with winged shafts.

sa: विस्मयं परमं जग्मुस्ततस्ते वसुधाधिपाः। तत् कर्म प्रेक्ष्य बीभत्सोरतिमानुषविक्रमम्॥
en: All the rulers of the earth present there, were filled with wonder. Then beholding that feat of Vibhatsu that indicated his superhuman prowess,

sa: एवं यो वर्तते राजा पौरजानपदेष्विह। अनुभूयेह भद्राणि प्राप्नोतीन्द्रसलोकताम्॥
en: A king, who behaves thus towards the people of his city and the provinces, enjoys prosperity here and lives in heaven with Indra.'

sa: विश्वामित्रस्य पुत्रत्वमृचीकतनयोऽगमत्। ऋग्भिः स्तुत्वा महाबाहो देवान् वै यज्ञभागिनः॥
en: Richika's became the of Vishvamitra. By worshipping the gods who have shares in sacrificial offerings, with Riches, (he acquired success in after life).

sa: एवमुक्ता तु भीमेन राक्षसी कामरूपिणी। भीमसेनं महात्मानमाह चैवमनिन्दित॥
en: Having been thus addressed by Bhima, the faultless Rakshasas woman, who could assume any form at will, thus replied to the high-souled Bhimasena.

sa: तावक्षतौ प्रमुदितौ दध्मतुर्वारिजोत्तमौ। दृष्टवा प्रमुदितान् पार्थांस्त्वदीया व्यथिता भृशम्॥
en: Both uninjured and cheerful and blowing their excellent conches, the Pandava troops were filled with delight whilst those of yours were greatly pained.

sa: सौतिकवाच शृणु ब्रह्मन्यथापृच्छन्मन्त्रिणो नृपतिस्तदा। यथा चाख्यातवन्तस्ते निधनं तत्परीक्षितः॥
en: Sauti said : O Brahmana, hear all that the king asked his ministers and all that they said about the death of Parikshit.

sa: ब्रह्मशंकरशक्राद्यैर्दैववृन्दैः पुनः पुनः। क्रीडसे त्वं नरव्याघ्र बालः क्रीडनकैरिव॥
en: O foremost of men, as children sport with their toys, you repeatedly sport with the celestials including Brahma, Shankara (Shiva) and Shakra (Indra).

sa: भृगुरुवाच मानसस्येह या मूर्तिर्ब्रह्मत्वं समुपागता। तस्यासनविधानार्थं पृथिवी पद्ममुच्यते॥
en: Bhrigu said The Earth is called that Lotus. It was created for giving a seat to that form of Manasa which became Brahman.

sa: अभिशस्तमिवात्मानं मन्यन्ते येन कर्मणा। तस्माद् राजर्षयः सर्वे ब्राह्मणानन्वपालयन्॥
en: For such an offence, kings consider themselves to be worthy of reproach. All righteous kings, therefore, provide Brahmanas with the means of sustenance,

sa: अधीयतेऽध्यापयन्ति यजन्ते याजयन्ति च। ददति प्रतिगृह्णन्ति षट्सु कर्मस्ववस्थिताः॥
en: The Brahmanas in my kingdom teach, study, sacrifice, officiate at others' sacrifices, give, and receive presents. All of them perform those six acts.

sa: तस्माच्च भगवान् देवः स्वयमेव हुताशनः। स्त्रीवेषमद्भुतं कृत्वा तत्रैवान्तरधीयत॥
en: From that place, the god (of fire) the consumer of offerings having himself assumed the wonderful form of a female vanished from sight.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु देवेन क्रोधमागातदार्जुनः। मन्युमभ्याविशद् घोरं स्मृत्वा तत्तु धनंजयः॥
en: Thus accosted by the deity Arjuna was worked up with anger. And recollecting all the incidents Dhananjaya was possessed by a terrific rage.

sa: अधर्मज्ञो महर्षीणां वाहनाच्च ततः शुभे। इष्टिं चाहं करिष्यामि विनाशायास्य दुर्मतेः॥ शक्रं चाधिगमिष्यामि मा भैस्त्वं भद्रमस्तु ते।
en: He is regardless of virtue so to say, having employed the great Rishis as his bearer, O lovely lady; and I shall perform sacrifices for the destruction of this evil minded one. I shall approach Shakra. You need not have any fears, I wish you well.

sa: तत एनं परिष्वज्य सखा विप्रो महातपाः। अकृतव्रणः शुभैर्वाक्यैराश्वासयदनेकधा॥
en: Then his friend, that twice-born and great ascetic named Akritavrana, embraced him again and again and soothed him with words of auspicious import.

sa: लाजैश्चन्दनचूर्णैश्च विकीर्य च जनास्ततः। ऊचुर्दिष्ट्या नृपाविघ्नः समाप्तोऽयं क्रतुस्तव॥
en: Sprinkling over him fried paddy and sandal paste; the people said “By good luck, O king, your sacrifice has been completed without obstruction.

sa: तन्मे दहति गात्राणि तूलराशिमिवानलः। यच्च वीरं न पश्यामिधनंजयमुपान्तिकात्॥
en: It (his absence) burns my body as fire does a heap of cotton. I do not see the heroic Dhananjaya at my side.

sa: रमणीये जनाकीर्णे नगरे वारणावते। सगणास्तत्र यास्यामो धृतराष्ट्रस्य शासनात्॥
en: Yudhisthira said : We go with our friends and followers to the charming and populous city of Varanavata at the command of Dhritarashtra.

sa: यदा त्वमन्यत नृपो जातकौतूहला इति। उवाचैतानेत्य तदा पाण्डवानम्बिकासुतः॥
en: When the king Dhritarashtra knew that their (Pandavas) curiosity had been awakened, then the son of Ambika, (Dhritarashtra) spoke thus to the Pandavas.

sa: यादृशैः संनिवसति यादृशांश्योपसेवते। यादृगिच्छेच्च भवितुं तादृग् भवति पूरुषः॥
en: A person becomes like those with whom he lives, and like those whom he respects, and like to what he wishes to be.

sa: स तमासाद्य धर्मज्ञमुपतस्थे महाव्रतम्। अर्जुनोऽस्मीति नामास्मै निवेद्याभ्यवदत् ततः॥
en: Approaching that Rishi of high vows and gifted with a knowledge of al duties, he said, 'I am Arjuna'-~and then awaited his pleasure.

sa: प्राज्वलन्नग्नयो राजन् पृथिवी समकम्पत। उदपानाश्च कुम्भाश्च प्रासिञ्चञ्छतशो जलम्॥
en: The fires were ablaze, o king and the earth shook; and well and water pots shot forth water by hundreds and flowed out.

sa: भूतिकामेन म]न सत्यमेतद् ब्रवीमि ते। ततः सर्वा महाभाग देवताः समरुद्गणाः॥ ऋषयश्च महाभागाः पृच्छन्ति स्म पितूंस्ततः। पितरः केन तुष्यन्ति मर्त्यानामल्पचेतसाम्॥ अक्षयं च कथं दानं भवेच्चैवोर्ध्वदेहिकम्।
en: After the celestial preceptor had said this the highly blessed celestials, with the Maruts, and the highly blessed Rishis questioned the departed Manes saying, You Pitris with what acts of human beings, who are generally gifted with little understandings, do you become pleased? What gifts made in course of such rites as are performed for improving the position of deceased persons in the other world become inexhaustible in efficacy?

sa: राक्षसानां पिशाचानां केचिच्चाप्युत्तरान् कुरून्। विचित्रगतयः सर्वे यानवाप्यामरैः सह॥
en: Amongst the Rakshasas and Pishachas, some proceeded to the country of the UttaraKurus. Others, moving delightfully, went in the company of the celestials.

sa: कथं नाम भवेत् कार्यमस्याभिर्भरतर्षभ॥ साहसं कृतवास्त्वं तु ह्यनुक्रोशानृपोत्तम।
en: How then, O best of Bharata's race will our object be accomplished? From pity, O best of kings, you have acted very indiscreetly.

sa: पाण्डवास्तु महेष्वासं कर्णं सौभद्रमेव च। सम्प्रहर्षात् समाजग्मुर्दोपदेयांश्च सर्वशः॥
en: The Pandavas full of joy, inet with the powerful bowman Karna as also with the son of Subhadra, and the children of Draupadi.

sa: तिस्रः कक्ष्या व्यतिक्रम्य केशवो राजवेश्मनः। वैचित्रवीर्यं राजानमभ्यगच्छदरिंदमः॥ प्रनष्टगतयोऽभूवन्
en: come to After traversing through the apartments of the royal abode, Keshava, the subduer of foes, came to the royal son of Vichitravirya.

sa: यथैव सर्वास्वापत्सु पासि वृष्णीञ्जनार्दन। तथैवास्मान् महाबाहो वृजिनात् त्रातुमर्हसि॥
en: O mighty-armed Janardana, as you save the Vrishnis from all calamities, so also, it behoves you to save us from this impending ruin.

sa: तालमात्राणि चापानि विकर्षन्तो महाबलाः। आर्जुनि शरवर्षेण समन्तात् पर्यवारयन्॥
en: Then those mighty car-warriors stretching their bows huge like palmyra trees, covered the son of Arjuna on all sides with showers of arrows.

sa: शीघ्रं गच्छत्वयं वीरो दण्डकान्परिरक्षितुम्॥ दूषणोऽस्य बलाध्यक्षो भविष्यति महाबलः।
en: Let that hero now speedily go to protect the Dandaka forest and the highly powerful Duşana shall be the commander of his forces.

sa: विभीषणेन सहितो राजपुत्रः प्रतापवान्। कृतस्वस्त्ययनो भ्रात्रा लक्ष्मणस्त्वरितो ययौ॥
en: Accompanied by Vibhīşaņa, that powerful son of the king-Lakşmaņa-after his brother had offered up prayers in his behalf, set off with all speed.

sa: युद्धे कापुरुषैनित्यं भवद्भिः प्रियवादिभिः। राजानमनुगच्छद्भिः सर्वं कृत्यं विनाशितम्॥ राजशेषा कृता लङ्का क्षीणः कोशो बलं हतम्। राजानमिममासाद्य सुहृच्चिह्नममित्रकम्॥
en: All the affairs of the monarch have been wrecked by you-cravens in fight, sleek-tongued, following the king (fawning) you have made Lankā contain only the king, the treasury is lean; and the forces have been slain. By the king you have done like foes in the guise of friends.

sa: राघवस्य प्रियार्थं तु सुतरां वीर्यशालिनाम्। हरीणां कर्मचेष्टाभिस्तुतोष रघुनन्दनः॥
en: And consequently Raghu's son was well pleased with the fortitude and exertions of the powerful monkeys, for bringing about what dear to Ravhava.

sa: ततस्तु सूर्यसंकाशौ दीप्यमानौ स्वतेजसा ॥ शुक्लमाल्याम्बरधरौ जानकी पर्युपस्थितौ।
en: Thereupon those two (brothers), resplendent like to the Sun by their own effulgence, and wearing white garlands and clothes, appeared near Janaka's daughter.

sa: ततो राक्षसमादाय विद्युज्जिद्वं महाबलम्। मायाविनं महामायं प्राविशद्यत्र मैथिली॥
en: Then, taking with him the highly strong Vidyujjihva, huge bodied and gifted with the powers of illusion, he entered where Mithila's daughter was.

sa: कुम्भकर्णस्तु दुर्धर्षो भ्रातुराज्ञाय शासनम्। तथेत्युक्त्वा महावीर्यः शयनादुत्पपात ह॥
en: The irrepressible Kumbhakarna possessed of prodigious prowess, learning the mandate of his brother, sa', ing, 'So be it', rose up from his bed.

sa: तेषां नो विप्रणष्टानां विन्ध्ये पर्वतसत्तमे। भृशं शोकपरीतानामहोरात्रगणा गताः॥
en: Many were the days and nights that we spent, overwhelmed with grief and having lost our way on that best of mountains Vindhya.

sa: निःसृता दक्षिणद्वारादङ्गदो यत्र यूथपः। तेषां निष्क्रममाणानामशुभं समजायत ॥
en: And (the Raksasa) sallied forth through the Southern Entrance, where that leader of herdsAngads-was stationed. And as they went out, evil omens appeared.

sa: तेन शङ्खविमिश्रेण भेरीशब्देन नादिना। उपयाति महाबाहू रामः परपुरंजयः॥
en: That captor of hostile capitals, the mightarmed Rāma, was advancing (upon Larikā) with the sounds of drums mixed with the blares of conchs.

sa: पूर्वद्वारं तु लङ्काया नीलो वानरपुंगवः। प्रहस्तं प्रतियोद्धा स्याद्वानरैर्बहुभिर्वृतः॥
en: Let that foremost of monkey, Nila, surrounded to by an immense number of monkeys, cope with Prahasta at the Eastern gate of Lankā.

sa: स राजा रोषताम्राक्षः प्रहस्तं मन्त्रिसत्तमम्। कालयुक्तमुवाचेदं वचो विपुलमर्थवत्॥
en: And with his eyes coppery with rage, the king asked his foreniost counsellor Prahasta, in words fraught with sense and suiting the season,

sa: ते कामरूपिणः क्रूरा दंष्ट्रिणः पिङ्गलेक्षणः। मातंगा इव नर्दन्तो ध्वस्तकेशा भयावहाः॥ परिवार्य महाकाया महाकायं खरात्मजम्। अभिजघ्नुस्ततो हृष्टाश्चालयन्तो नभस्तलम्॥
en: They were armed with various weapons, cautious; assuming shapes at will, crooked, having fearful teeth, coppery eyes; roaring like elephants, having dishevelled hair and terrible. And encircling the huge-bodied son of Khara, those gigantic (Raksasas) began to proceed, delighted and moving the earth (with the weight of their persons).

sa: कथं नाम दशग्रीव साक्षाद्वैश्रवणानुज। हन्तुमिच्छसि वैदेही क्रोधाद्धर्ममपास्य च॥
en: Wherefore, O Ten-necked one, O you who are the very younger brother of Vaiśravaņa himself, Did you desire to slay Vaidehī, forsaking righteousness?

sa: तथागतां समुत्थाप्य सपल्यस्ता भृशातुराः॥ पर्यवस्थापयामास् रुदत्यो रुदतीं भृशम्।
en: Thereupon the other wives of Rāvaņa greatly distressed and weeping and rasing her up who was greatly weeping, began to console her saying.

sa: यदि ह्येवंविधः स्वप्नो दुःखितायाः प्रदृश्यते॥ सा दुःखैर्विविधैर्मुक्ता सुखमाप्नोत्यनुत्तमम्।
en: If we relate such a dream to the aggrieved one, she being freed from her diverse woes, shall attain the height of joy.

sa: ततो मारुतवत् क्रुद्धो मारुतिर्भीमविक्रमः। ऊरुवेगेन महता दुमान् क्षेप्तुमथारभत्॥
en: Then furious like the Wind, the offspring of the Wind-god possessed of dreadful prowess set about knocking down the trees with impetuous violence.

sa: ततः प्रवृत्तं तुमुलं हरीणां राक्षसैः सह। घोराणां भीमरूपाणामन्योन्यवधकाक्षिणाम्॥
en: Then there came on a terrific encounter of the monkeys and the Räksasas, dreadful, of terrific deeds, and wishing for each other' death.

sa: निवर्तमानः संहृष्टो रावणः स दुरात्मवान्। जहे पथि नरेन्द्रषिदेवदानवकन्यकाः॥
en: While thus returning the vicious-souled Rāvana, with delight, carried away stealthily, on his way, the daughters of the royal saints, celestials and Dänavas.

sa: तस्यैतौ राक्षसेन्द्रस्य मन्त्रिणौ शुकसारणौ। लङ्कायाः समनुप्राप्तौ चारौ परपुरंजय॥
en: These are the counsellors of the lord of Raksasas-Suka and Sarana. O captor of hostile capitals, they have come as spies from Lankā.

sa: देशम्य रमणीयत्वात्पुलस्त्यो यत्र स द्विजः। गायन्त्यो वादयन्त्यश्च लासयन्त्यस्तथैव च॥ मुनेस्तपस्विनस्तस्य विघ्नं चक्रुरनिन्दिताः। अथ रुष्टो महातेजा व्याजहार महामुनिः॥
en: And on account of the beauty of that region, those wenches, coming to where that twice-born one, Pulastya was, used to sing, to play on instruments, and to dance; and thus those blameless beauties disturbed the rites of that anchoret practising austerities. Thereat, the mighty ascetic, waxing wroth, said,

sa: यदि मां प्रति युद्धयेरन्देवगन्धर्वदानवाः। नैव सीतां प्रदास्यामि सर्वलोकभयादपि॥
en: Even if gods, and Gandharvas, and Danavas should array themselves against me, I will not from fear of all creatures, render (back) Sītā.

sa: कथंचित्यपरिपश्यामि लचितं वरुणालयम्। हतमित्येव तं मन्ये युद्धे शत्रुनिबर्हण॥
en: If I see any means of crossing the ocean, Varuna's abode, I shall, O destroyer of foes, deem him as slain in battle.

sa: ततश्चाराः संत्वरिताः प्राप्ताः पार्थिवशासनात्। उपस्थिताः प्राञ्जलयो वर्धयित्वा जयाशिषः॥
en: Thereat, the spies, hurriedly arriving there at the mandate of the monarch, and, presenting themselves, stood with joined hands, uttering blessing of victory.

sa: ननाद च महानादं समुद्रमभिनादयन्। विजयन्निव निर्घातान्विधमन्निव पर्वतान् ॥
en: Then he sent up a mighty shout making the sea resound, and as if drowning the roar of the thunder and riving mountains.

sa: यथा च स महाबाहुः पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननः। समाश्वासयितुं न्याय्यः सीतादर्शनलालसः॥
en: She is worthy of being consoled like to the great armed (Rāma) having the countenance of the full-moon and anxious to behold Sita.

sa: महोदरः सुसंक्रुद्धः शरैः काञ्चनभूषणैः। चिच्छेद पाणिपादोरु वानराणां महाहवे।९।।
en: And Mahodara, greatly angered, severed in that mighty encounter, with his arrows feathered in gold, the hands, feet and thighs of the monkeys.

sa: वासवस्य वचः श्रुत्वा सर्वलोकपितामहः। रक्षास्यावाहयामास कुम्भकर्म ददर्श ह॥
en: Hearing Vasava's speech, the Great-father of all creatures called up* the Rākṣasas and saw Kumbhakarņa (before him). *By reciting a certain scriptural formula.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तथेत्युक्त्वा राक्षसेन्द्रो महोदरः। प्रविवेशारिसेनां स पतङ्ग इव पावकम्।६॥
en: Being thus accosted that Räkşasa chief Mahodara saying "so be it” entered the enemy's army like to a fly entering into a flame.

sa: जघान बलिनं रामः सहस्रनयनात्मजम्। वालिनं मेघसंकाशं पर्याप्तं तन्निदर्शनम्॥
en: Rāma slew the powerful Vāli, the son of the thousand eyed one, resembling the cloud-that too was the sufficient proof of his prowess.

sa: ते बभुः शुकनीलाङ्गाः सशला रजनीचरः। विद्युन्मण्डलसंनद्धाः सबलाक इवाम्बुदाः॥
en: With conchs placed in their mouths, those night-rangers, having bodies blue like those of Śukas, resembled masses of clouds, with lightning and cranes.

sa: ते वर्धयित्वा काकुत्स्थं रामेण प्रतिनन्दिताः। अनुजग्मुर्महात्मानं भ्रातृभिः परिवारितम्॥
en: They having bowed to that descendant of Kākutstha were welcomed by him. And they followed that high souled one encircled by his brothers.

sa: विघ्नमन्विच्छता तत्र वानराणां पराक्रमे॥ ससैन्यास्तत्र गच्छामो यावत्तन्न समाप्यते।
en: Thither will we go before he has furnished his (sacrifice). O foremost of men, shake off this vain sorrow that has overcome you!

sa: स जृम्भमाणोऽतिबलः प्रबुद्धस्तु निशाचरः। निःपासश्चास्य संजज्ञे पर्वतादिव मारुतः॥
en: That night ranger possessed of unwieldly strength woke up, yawning. And the breath that he breathed resembled a storm raging in a mountain.

sa: रावणिस्तु सुसंस्क्रुद्धस्तानिरीक्ष्य निशाचरान्। हृष्टा भवन्तो युध्यन्तु वानराणां जिघांसया॥
en: Rāvana's son, fired with wrath, seeing those night-rangers, addressed them, saying, “Do you, burning with a desire to destroy the monkeys, fight cheerfully."

sa: मम वर्णो मणिनिभौ मृदून्यङ्गरुहाणि च। प्रतिष्ठितां द्वादशभिरमामूचुः शुभलक्षणाम्॥
en: My complexion is like the hue of gems, and my down soft. And they said that I was furnished with twelve auspicious signs.

sa: उदकुम्भशतानन्ये समसिञ्चन्त कर्णयोः। न कुम्भकर्णः पस्पन्दे महानिद्रावशं गतः॥
en: Others poured into his ears a thousand vessels of water. But Kumbhakarņa come under the spell of a mighty slumber did not wink.

sa: नूनं त्रिभुवनस्यापि पर्याप्तस्त्वमसि प्रभो। स कस्मात्प्राकृत इव शोचस्यात्मानमीदृशम्॥
en: O lord, you certainly alone are competent to conquer the triple world. Wherefore then did you went such sorrow like an ignoble one?

sa: कालाः काञ्चनसंनाहास्तरिमम्मरसि राक्षसाः। संप्रदृश्यन्त शैलेन्द्रा दीप्तौषधिवना इव ॥
en: And, dark-hued, the Raksasas, equipped in golden mail, in that deep darkness appeared like elevated hills clad with woods of flaming incdicinal herbs.

sa: अथ नामाकरोतस्य पितामहसमः पिता। दशग्रीवः प्रसूतोऽयं दशग्रीवो भविष्यति॥
en: And his sire resembling his grand-father named him, (saying), 'As this one has been born with ten necks, he shall be called Ten-necked.'

sa: मनसा ब्रह्मणा सृष्टे विमाने भरताग्रजः। रराज पृथुदीर्घाक्षो वज्रपाणिरिवामरः॥
en: There appeared in the car constructed by Brahmā's mind the elder brother of Bharata having expansive eyes like the immortal wielder of thunder-bolt.

sa: श्रुत्वा तां मैथिली रामस्त्वाशशंसे च जीवितम्। जीवितान्तमनुप्राप्तः पीत्वामृतमिवातुरः॥
en: Hearing (of the news of Vaidehi) Rama regained his life like one on the verge of death regaining his being after drinking nectar.

sa: नारायणशरत्रस्तं शङ्खनादसुविह्वलम्। ययौ लङ्कामभिमुखं प्रभग्नं राक्षसं बलम् ॥
en: Agitated by the arrows of Nārāyaṇa, with their senses bewildered by the blares of the conch, the broken Raksasa forces made for Lankā.

sa: सुग्रीवो ग्रीवया सीते भग्नया प्लवगाधिपः। निरस्तहनुकः सीते हनूमानराक्षसैर्हतः॥
en: O Sītā, Sugriva lord of monkeys-has his neck broken; and, O Sītā, with his jaw fractured, Hanuman has been slaughtered by the Rākşasas.

sa: दीनवक्त्रेक्षणाः श्यामा मृग्यः सिंहवशा इव। काचिच्चिन्तयती तत्र किं नु मां भक्षयिष्यति॥ काचिद्दध्यौ सुदुःखार्ता अपि मां मारयेदयम्।
en: The countenance and eyes, of those beautiful damsels, brought under the subjection of the tennecked demon, and afflicted with sorrow, looked poorly like a hind attacked by a lion. Some thought, “Will he eat me up" and another, stricken with sorrow, thought, “Will he destroy me?"

sa: निवृत्तवनवासं च त्वया सार्धमरिंदमम्। अभिषिक्तमयोध्यायां क्षिप्रं द्रक्ष्यसि राघवम्॥
en: You shall soon behold Rāghava, the slayer of foes, installed along with you on the throne of Ayodhya after returning from the forest.

sa: स तैः सम्पीड्यमानोऽपि रक्षोभिर्भीमविक्रमैः। विस्मयं परमं गत्वा रक्षोऽधिपमवैक्षत॥
en: Undergoing exceeding trouble at the hands of the Rākṣasa of dreadful prowess, (Hanumān) struck with mighty amaze, gazed at the lord of Raksasas.

sa: विनेदुश्च यथाप्राणं हरयो जितकाशिनः। चकृषुश्च पुनस्तत्र सप्राणानेव राक्षसान्॥
en: The monkeys eager for victory shouted with might and main, and began to drag the Rākşasas with the view of taking their lives.

sa: स वायुसूनुः कुपितश्चिक्षेप शिखरं गिरेः। त्रिशिरास्तच्छरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्बिभेद बहुधा बली॥
en: Thereat the wind-god's son, enraged, hurled a mountain-peak (at his adversary). And Trisiras by means of keen arrows severed the same in shivers.

sa: अशोको विजयश्चैव सिद्धार्थश्च समाहिताः। मन्त्रयनरामवृद्ध्यर्थं वृत्त्यर्थं नगरस्य च॥
en: Asoka, Vijaya and Siddhārtha, with undivided mind, consulted with each other about the welfare of Rāma as well as that of the city.
